ai-engineer._descripcion: En Blend somos un proveedor premium de servicios de IA que acompaña a las empresas más grandes del mundo a dar el salto: de experimentar con inteligencia artificial a generar valor real, a escala. Lo hacemos co-creando junto a nuestros clientes, uniendo ciencia de datos, ingeniería, tecnología y talento humano para resolver los retos más ambiciosos y convertirlos en oportunidades de crecimiento. Eso es lo que nos hace diferentes: no entregamos proyectos, construimos impacto que se sostiene en el tiempo. Somos más de 1.500 personas en el mundo (500+ en LATAM), y contamos con la certificación Great Place To Work® 2026/2027, una señal clara del compromiso que tenemos con la experiencia y el bienestar de nuestro equipo. Y no solo lo decimos nosotros: en 2026 fuimos nombrados por Constellation Research como una de las AI-First Service Firms del mundo y nos convertimos en OpenAI Services Partner. Si quieres conocer más sobre quiénes somos y hacia dónde vamos, esos dos enlaces son un excelente punto de partida. Creemos que la combinación entre las personas y la inteligencia artificial puede transformar el mundo. Descripción del cargo Diseñarás y liderarás plataformas de datos y modelos que alimentan analítica e IA para clientes enterprise y sector público. Proyectos tipo: motores de auditoría automática de reclamaciones, lagos de datos institucionales, plataformas territoriales con modelos de ML, scoring y detección de anomalías. Liderarás pruebas de concepto competitivas y las llevarás a producción, frente al cliente y con un equipo a cargo. Si vienes de ML, estadística o matemáticas con dominio sobresaliente (por ejemplo, resultados destacados en Kaggle, posgrado o publicaciones) y programas bien, también aplica aunque tu trayectoria en ingeniería de datos sea menor. 🎯 Responsabilidades clave Diseñar arquitecturas de lago, lakehouse o data warehouse por capas, eligiendo con argumentos entre S3 con Athena, Snowflake y Databricks. Construir ingesta por lotes, CDC y streaming. Construir features, entrenar, validar y desplegar modelos, cuidando fugas de datos, sesgo y estabilidad en el tiempo. Definir calidad, linaje, gobierno y control de acceso a datos sensibles. Optimizar Spark y el costo de procesamiento. Liderar pruebas de concepto competitivas y llevarlas a producción frente al cliente. Guiar técnicamente al equipo a cargo. 🧠 Requerimientos Experiencia y habilidades (Requeridas/Indispensables) 4+ años en ingeniería de datos, ML o ciencia de datos, con 2+ años liderando técnicamente. Al menos una plataforma de datos o un modelo en producción diseñado por ti, no solo piezas sueltas. Liderazgo de una prueba de concepto o proyecto frente a cliente, porque en este rol respondes directamente ante clientes exigentes. AWS (S3, Glue, Athena, Lake Formation, DMS, Step Functions, SageMaker), Snowflake o Databricks, dbt y MLflow. Python, PySpark y SQL avanzados; scikit-learn, XGBoost o LightGBM y PyTorch; estadística aplicada (inferencia, series de tiempo, diseño experimental). Uso avanzado y diario de Claude Code, Codex o similares, con evidencia verificable. Todo muy bien. Certificación AWS Data Engineer o ML Engineer Associate, SnowPro o Databricks. Kaggle Expert o superior. Power Skils/Competencias Liderazgo técnico: lideras pruebas de concepto y equipos frente al cliente. Rigor en la validación de modelos: validas de verdad, con atención a fugas de datos, sesgo y estabilidad en el tiempo. Manejo de clientes exigentes: sacas adelante una prueba de concepto frente a un cliente exigente. Argumentación técnica: eliges entre S3 con Athena, Snowflake y Databricks con argumentos. 💰 Sobre el salario: Ahora mismo estamos finalizando un estudio de mercado desde People Ops para definir el rango exacto de este rol, así que aún no tenemos un número cerrado para compartir en esta etapa. Por eso, en el formulario de aplicación te preguntaremos tu expectativa salarial —así podemos tenerla Lo que ofrecemos Grow and Get Together — Programa de beneficios Blend. Creamos experiencias que impulsan tu bienestar, desarrollo y conexión, dentro y fuera del trabajo. 🎓 Educación y desarrollo Subsidios condonables para programas de educación formal, certificaciones o formaciones especializadas Acceso a Udemy Business Clases grupales de inglés Certificaciones AWS 🌎 Work Together: Posibilidad de trabajo remoto desde el exterior hasta por 2 meses al año 🎉 Días especiales Cumpleaños: 1 día libre Navidad y Año Nuevo En BLEND360 estamos comprometidos con construir un lugar de trabajo inclusivo y damos la bienvenida a candidatos y candidatas de perfiles, orígenes y experiencias diversas.

Na CI&T , ajudamos grandes empresas a transformar o potencial da AI em impacto real nos negócios com AI Deployment, execução AI-native e tech-integrated business solutions.

Com 30 anos de experiência em transformação tecnológica, aceleramos inovação com expertise em agentic SDLC, application modernization, Data & AI, martech e business strategy.

Somos 8.000 CI&Ters em mais de 25 países, colaborando para construir soluções com impacto real. AI já faz parte da forma como trabalhamos, evoluímos e inovamos todos os dias.

**Importante**: se você reside na Região Metropolitana de Campinas, sua presença nos escritórios da cidade será obrigatória, conforme a política de frequencia vigente.

Olá, aqui é a Tamara da CI&T!  
  
**Sobre a oportunidade de AI Engineer/Software Architect:**  
  
A CI&T está montando um novo programa: para modernizar um legado do nosso cliente e levar todas as jornadas do Portal do Cliente para a arquitetura nova.

Esta é uma posição sênior e hands-on. Você será a referência técnica em engenharia assistida por IA dentro da sua frente. Seu papel é transformar a IA em vantagem concreta de prazo e qualidade em um cenário de legado pouco documentado, com muitas integrações e meta de desligamento agressiva.

**O que você vai fazer:**

Responder pela entrega técnica da frente, garantindo qualidade, previsibilidade e aderência aos padrões arquiteturais: React com micro-frontend, NodeJS, em EKS/AWS e Cognito.  
Conduzir a engenharia reversa do legado assistida por IA, extraindo do código (.do, .jsp, .aspx) a hierarquia de telas, as regras de negócio e os serviços consumidos.  
Transformar esse conhecimento em especificações e documentação viva, usando Spec-Driven Development (Spec-Kit, BMAD) como base, já que hoje as regras só existem no handoff do Figma.  
Desenvolver e acelerar a migração das telas, isolando as integrações legadas em adapters no BFF e reaproveitando componentes comuns entre produtos.  
Implementar processos agênticos ao longo do fluxo da frente: code review com IA, geração e manutenção de testes, refatoração assistida e automação de PRs.  
Apoiar o IA Orchestrator e a PO no refinamento técnico e na organização do backlog, estimando fluxos (P/M/G/GG), sinalizando riscos e priorizando oportunidades de automação.  
Avaliar trade-offs de integração entre front, BFF e gateways (Flex Gateway/MuleSoft), considerando as dependências com outras equipes da Porto.  
Mentorar os engenheiros da frente e elevar a maturidade do time em desenvolvimento com Claude Code e ferramentas agênticas.

**O que esperamos de você:**

Experiência prática profunda com ferramentas agênticas de desenvolvimento, em particular Claude Code.  
Domínio de Spec-Driven Development (Spec-Kit e/ou BMAD) e capacidade de aplicá-lo a projetos de migração e modernização.  
Vivência sólida full stack com React/Next.js e Node, e com arquitetura de micro-frontends e BFF.  
Experiência com migração ou modernização de sistemas legados, de preferência Java web (JSP/Struts ou similares).  
Uso de IA para entender código legado: engenharia reversa, extração de regras de negócio e mapeamento de dependências.  
Repertório em processos agênticos aplicados ao desenvolvimento, como code review com IA, agentes para QA e automações de pipeline.  
Visão sistêmica para enxergar arquitetura, dependências e impactos entre times e sistemas.  
Experiência em refinamento técnico junto a Product Owners e responsabilidade direta pela entrega técnica de um time.

**Diferenciais;**

Vivência com AWS (EKS, Cognito) e com gateways de API (MuleSoft/Flex Gateway).  
Vivência com MCP (Model Context Protocol) e construção de agentes customizados para fluxos de engenharia.

ai-engineer._descripcion:
We are seeking a **Senior/Staff Evaluation AI Engineer** to anchor the rigorous benchmarking, validation, and safety of our next-generation Agentic AI platform. Our platform automates highly complex enterprise workflows for corporate real estate (CRE), including automated lease abstraction, predictive portfolio optimization, and intelligent space management.  
This role sits at the intersection of Quality Engineering, Software Engineering, and AI/ML. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on automation skills and experience testing LLM-, RAG-, and agent-based applications, with the ability to translate AI quality expectations into measurable evaluation criteria and automated regression suites.

The AI Evaluation Engineer will partner closely with Engineering, Product, Data, and Quality Engineering teams to ensure AI capabilities are measurable, explainable, reliable, and production-ready.

Duration: 6 months but high chance for prolongation in case of good performance, as this is long term role

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Architect Evaluation Frameworks: Design, implement, and scale custom automated evaluation pipelines for multi-agent LLM systems, focusing on intent-classification, tool-calling correctness, state transition integrity, checkpointer manipulation and multi-turn memory replay.
* Define Domain-Specific Metrics: Develop advanced custom metrics (incorporating G-Eval, LLM-as-a-judge architectures, and deterministic verification methods) to evaluate domain-specific tasks like complex document parsing (leases, invoices) and real estate financial modeling.
* Establish Guardrails & Safety Protocols: Implement defensive alignment testing, adversarial red-teaming, and prompt injection mitigation to prevent hallucination, data leakage, and unauthorized tool execution within corporate cloud environments.
* Build the Benchmarking Infrastructure: Construct robust evaluation datasets, golden regression sets, and synth-data pipelines that mimic real-world property manager, tenant, and broker behaviors.
* Monitor System Drift & Observability: Monitor live, production-grade agent workflows for behavioral drift, latency regressions, cost inefficiencies, and token utilization over time.
* Build Automated Evaluation Infrastructure: Design, develop, and maintain scalable evaluation frameworks and pipelines using Python, SQL, APIs, and CI/CD to execute hundreds or thousands of evaluation cases across models, prompts, RAG pipelines, and AI agents.
* Develop Evaluation Metrics and Graders: Implement automated grading approaches using deterministic validation, reference-based evaluation, human-defined rubrics, LLM-as-a-Judge, and human-in-the-loop evaluation. Establish scoring criteria and quality thresholds appropriate to each AI use case.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 5 to 7 years of experience in software engineering, quality engineering, test automation, AI engineering, machine learning, or a related technical role.
* Hands-on experience evaluating or testing LLM, NLP, machine learning, or AI applications.
* Strong Python skills and experience building automated test or evaluation workflows.
* Experience creating and maintaining golden datasets, test datasets, or benchmark datasets.
* Experience with adversarial testing.
* Familiarity with AI Safety, security & Privacy, and Responsible AI evaluation.
* Deep structural expertise in LangChain, LangGraph (including sub-graphs and conditional routing) and LangSmith.
* Hands-on experience using LangSmith for tracing, debugging, experiments, datasets, and evaluations.
* Strong GitHub experience, including repositories, branching, pull requests, code reviews, and CI/CD workflows.
* Experience using Claude Code or similar AI-assisted development tools.
* Experience with AWS and Amazon Bedrock.
* Experience with REST APIs, JSON, SQL, and modern application architectures.
* Strong understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, RAG, and AI agents.
* Experience with automated testing, regression testing, integration testing, and end-to-end testing.
* Hands-on experience evaluating LangGraph-based or multi-agent applications at the node and state-transition level.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of ambiguous technical problems.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with Ragas, DeepEval, Arize Phoenix, TruLens, Promptfoo, or similar evaluation tools.
* Experience with LLM-as-a-judge and human-in-the-loop evaluation approaches.
* Experience with Bedrock Agents, Knowledge Bases for Amazon Bedrock, Lambda, S3, or CloudWatch.
* Experience integrating AI evaluations into GitHub Actions.

ai-engineer._descripcion:
OUR VISION & PRODUCTS

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next



At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!




OUR TEAM

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.



Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23



Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)



Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)



Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)




YOUR ROLE

Most LLM roles stop at experimentation.

Here, the models you improve power experiences for 50M+ users.

Most of our traffic runs on self-hosted, fine-tuned open-weight models. On our internal roleplay evals, our smaller fine-tuned models can outperform much larger off-the-shelf models. Your job is to make them better.

You’ll join a small AI team led by Marco, our LLM Tech Lead, working closely with our CTO, Product, Web and DevOps teams. You’ll work across data, post-training, evals, and model behavior, taking ideas from failure analysis to production.

The problems are real: personalization, character consistency, long conversations, better evals, multilingual behavior, and faster training cycles.

If you want to shape model behavior at consumer scale, this is the role.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Fine-tune open-weight LLMs using SFT, LoRA/QLoRA and post-training methods such as DPO and GRPO

 - Diagnose model failures and turn them into experiments. Decide whether the answer is better data, post-training, prompting or classifiers

 - Build training data and evals that directly shape what gets trained next

 - Improve model behavior across personalization, consistency, tone, multilingual and group interactions

 - Ship to production and use real user behavior to guide the next iteration

 - Speed up the training loop so experiments are faster, easier to compare, and more reproducible




YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

 - You’ve personally post-trained open-weight LLMs for a user-facing product and shipped them to production

 - You’ve worked where AI was core to the product or business, not an experimental side feature

 - Fine-tuning is core to your experience

 - Strong Python, PyTorch and Hugging Face, with hands-on GPU training and debugging

 - You build data and evals yourself and make decisions from evidence

 - You can take work beyond notebooks into production

 - You use AI tools daily in your own engineering work

 - You are fully comfortable working with uncensored models and explicit NSFW content, including harmful material when developing and evaluating moderation system




BONUS POINTS

 - Experience with conversational AI, roleplay products, or highly personalized consumer AI

 - Multilingual LLMs

 - Moderation, safety, or adversarial testing

 - Multimodal models

 - Open-source LLM / post-training contributions




WHY EVERAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale




WHAT WE OFFER

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows




🎯 TOP TIER TALENT IS OUR MULTIPLIER

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

OUR VISION & PRODUCTS

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next



At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!




OUR TEAM

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.



Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23



Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)



Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)




YOUR ROLE

Most LLM roles stop at experimentation.

Here, the models you improve power experiences for 50M+ users.

Most of our traffic runs on self-hosted, fine-tuned open-weight models. On our internal roleplay evals, our smaller fine-tuned models can outperform much larger off-the-shelf models. Your job is to make them better.

You’ll join a small AI team led by Marco, our LLM Tech Lead, working closely with our CTO, Product, Web and DevOps teams. You’ll work across data, post-training, evals, and model behavior, taking ideas from failure analysis to production.

The problems are real: personalization, character consistency, long conversations, better evals, multilingual behavior, and faster training cycles.

If you want to shape model behavior at consumer scale, this is the role.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Fine-tune open-weight LLMs using SFT, LoRA/QLoRA and post-training methods such as DPO and GRPO

 - Diagnose model failures and turn them into experiments. Decide whether the answer is better data, post-training, prompting or classifiers

 - Build training data and evals that directly shape what gets trained next

 - Improve model behavior across personalization, consistency, tone, multilingual and group interactions

 - Ship to production and use real user behavior to guide the next iteration

 - Speed up the training loop so experiments are faster, easier to compare, and more reproducible




YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

 - You’ve personally post-trained open-weight LLMs for a user-facing product and shipped them to production

 - You’ve worked where AI was core to the product or business, not an experimental side feature

 - Fine-tuning is core to your experience

 - Strong Python, PyTorch and Hugging Face, with hands-on GPU training and debugging

 - You build data and evals yourself and make decisions from evidence

 - You can take work beyond notebooks into production

 - You use AI tools daily in your own engineering work

 - You are fully comfortable working with uncensored models and explicit NSFW content, including harmful material when developing and evaluating moderation system




BONUS POINTS

 - Experience with conversational AI, roleplay products, or highly personalized consumer AI

 - Multilingual LLMs

 - Moderation, safety, or adversarial testing

 - Multimodal models

 - Open-source LLM / post-training contributions




WHY EVERAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale




WHAT WE OFFER

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows




🎯 TOP TIER TALENT IS OUR MULTIPLIER

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

ai-engineer._descripcion: En Aristocrat, estamos impulsando la tecnología del sector del gaming mediante soluciones modernas y potentes. Nuestra misión es llevar alegría a la vida a través del juego. Valoramos la colaboración, la creatividad y un fuerte compromiso con la excelencia. Este puesto dará soporte principalmente al área de Machine Learning de nuestra unidad de negocio Product Madness, una empresa tecnológica especializada en juegos móviles de casino social. Buscamos un/a Ingeniero/a de Machine Learning para unirse a nuestro equipo de MLOps y reforzar nuestras capacidades de modelado. Serás responsable de los modelos de Machine Learning de principio a fin, desde los datos y la experimentación hasta su puesta en producción, y contribuirás a desarrollar una cultura sólida de monitorización y experimentación que garantice que nuestros modelos sigan siendo fiables y estén alineados con las necesidades del negocio a lo largo del tiempo. Tu trabajo tendrá un impacto real en nuestros productos y en la experiencia de nuestros jugadores. Qué harás Diseñar, entrenar, evaluar y reentrenar modelos de Machine Learning, con especial énfasis en sistemas de recomendación, para dar soporte a funcionalidades de los juegos, mejorar la experiencia de los jugadores y optimizar la eficiencia operativa. Liderar el diseño de la monitorización del rendimiento de nuestros modelos: definir qué métricas y aspectos deben supervisarse (drift, calidad de los datos, degradación del rendimiento), establecer umbrales y determinar qué significa que un modelo siga siendo fiable desde una perspectiva de negocio. Ayudar a establecer una cultura sólida de experimentación mediante el versionado de modelos y el seguimiento de experimentos con herramientas como MLflow o Weights & Biases, garantizando que los experimentos sean reproducibles y que las distintas versiones de los modelos puedan compararse y promoverse fácilmente. Contribuir al desarrollo de una cultura de gobernanza de modelos: definir cómo se promueven los modelos a producción y establecer las bases del proceso de comunicación y colaboración entre los equipos de MLOps y Data Science. Crear plantillas y estructuras reutilizables, como Cookiecutter, para estandarizar la forma en que el equipo de Data Science estructura, entrega y comunica sus modelos y experimentos. Construir pipelines robustos de entrenamiento y feature engineering, y desarrollar código limpio y preparado para producción en Python y SQL. Explorar y contribuir a proyectos en fases iniciales relacionados con LLMs, RAG y Agentic AI cuando aporten valor, como complemento del puesto y no como su responsabilidad principal. Desarrollar interfaces sencillas, por ejemplo con Streamlit, para acercar las capacidades de Machine Learning a usuarios no técnicos cuando resulte útil. Colaborar con equipos de Producto, Datos e Ingeniería, comunicando de manera clara los resultados, las limitaciones y las recomendaciones tanto a audiencias técnicas como de negocio. Qué buscamos Más de 4 años de experiencia aplicando Machine Learning a problemas reales, desde el tratamiento de datos hasta el despliegue de modelos. Experiencia demostrable con sistemas de recomendación —como collaborative filtering, ranking o técnicas similares— aplicados a productos reales. Sólidos conocimientos de Python y experiencia práctica con librerías de Machine Learning como scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow, XGBoost o similares. Sólidos conocimientos de SQL y experiencia trabajando con grandes data warehouses. Experiencia práctica con herramientas de seguimiento de experimentos y/o registros de modelos, como MLflow, Weights & Biases o equivalentes. Experiencia diseñando o contribuyendo a sistemas de monitorización y seguimiento del rendimiento de modelos en producción. Experiencia trabajando con plataformas cloud como GCP, AWS o Azure, así como con Docker y Airflow. Una sólida base analítica, con formación en un área cuantitativa como matemáticas, física, informática o ingeniería, o experiencia profesional equivalente. Se valorará Experiencia con Snowflake u otros data warehouses similares en la nube. Experiencia práctica desarrollando aplicaciones con IA generativa (LLMs), incluida la integración mediante APIs. Interés o experiencia inicial con sistemas RAG, ya sea mediante prototipos, proyectos personales o experiencia profesional. Interés o familiaridad con conceptos o frameworks de Agentic AI, como LangChain Agents o CrewAI. Capacidad para desarrollar interfaces de usuario sencillas, por ejemplo con Streamlit, que permitan acercar los modelos de Machine Learning a otros equipos. ¿Por qué Aristocrat? Aristocrat es una empresa líder mundial en contenido y tecnología para la industria del gaming, así como uno de los principales publishers de juegos móviles free-to-play. Aristocrat cuenta con tres unidades de negocio que abarcan el gaming regulado presencial ( Aristocrat Gaming ), el casino social ( Product Madness ) y el gaming online regulado con dinero real ( Aristocrat Interactive ). Nuestro equipo, formado por más de 7.300 empleados en todo el mundo , comparte una misma misión: llevar alegría a la vida a través del poder del juego. Ofrecemos un excelente rendimiento a nuestros clientes B2B y llevamos entretenimiento a millones de personas que disfrutan de nuestros juegos de casino y juegos móviles. Y aunque nos centramos en crear experiencias divertidas, nunca olvidamos nuestras responsabilidades. Nos esforzamos por liderar el camino en materia de juego responsable y por elevar continuamente nuestros estándares de gobierno corporativo, bienestar de los empleados y sostenibilidad. Somos una empresa diversa, unida por valores compartidos y por una misión inspiradora: llevar alegría a la vida a través del poder del juego. Expectativas de viaje Se requiere una disponibilidad mínima para viajar, de hasta un 5 % . Información adicional Dependiendo de las características de tu puesto, es posible que debas registrarte ante la Nevada Gaming Control Board (NGCB) y/o ante otros organismos reguladores de las jurisdicciones de gaming en las que operamos. Esta descripción del puesto puede haber sido revisada y optimizada mediante herramientas de inteligencia artificial con el fin de mejorar su claridad, coherencia e inclusión. En cualquier caso, todo el contenido final, los requisitos del puesto y las decisiones de contratación están sujetos a la revisión y aprobación de Aristocrat. Filosofía de compensación Ofrecemos un paquete integral de remuneración y beneficios diseñado para seguir siendo competitivo en el mercado, apoyar tu bienestar y reconocer tu contribución a nuestro éxito. Nuestro enfoque se basa en una filosofía de remuneración por desempeño, recompensando el impacto individual. Tu paquete de compensación específico se determinará en función de factores como tus habilidades, experiencia, cualificaciones y ubicación. Dependiendo de tu puesto y ubicación, podrás optar a bonificaciones e incentivos anuales, beneficios de salud y bienestar, tiempo libre remunerado, planes de jubilación, cobertura de seguros y otros beneficios locales o establecidos por la legislación aplicable. ai-engineer._descripcion:
WebCreek is looking for a Senior Video Systems & AI Developer to drive the development of a mission-critical video management and AI-powered video analytics platform.

The ideal candidate has extensive hands-on experience with video management systems (VMS), real-time video processing, computer vision, and vision-language models (VLMs). This role involves developing scalable solutions for camera integration, video recording, storage, playback, and intelligent video analytics, while providing technical guidance to an in-house developer.

This position is well suited for a senior developer who combines strong software development expertise with technical leadership, enjoys solving complex video processing challenges, and can take ownership of architectural decisions and production-ready solutions.

**What You'll Do:**

* Lead the technical development of video management and AI-powered analytics capabilities, providing architectural guidance and mentoring an in-house engineer.
* Design, develop, and maintain video management services supporting camera ingestion, recording, storage, playback, and live streaming.
* Build and optimize video processing pipelines using GStreamer, FFmpeg, and protocols such as RTSP/RTP and ONVIF.
* Develop solutions supporting H.264/H.265 and MJPEG video formats across multiple camera types and integrations.
* Design scalable video storage architectures, including continuous and event-based recording, retention policies, and object storage using Azure Blob Storage or Amazon S3.
* Implement browser-based video delivery supporting multiple concurrent camera feeds using technologies such as WebCodecs, Media Source Extensions (MSE), and WebRTC.
* Develop and integrate computer vision capabilities, including object detection, tracking, and GPU-accelerated inference.
* Integrate vision-language models (VLMs) and large language models (LLMs) into video analytics workflows, including tool calling, structured outputs, and model evaluation.
* Develop and maintain backend services using Node.js, GraphQL, MySQL, Redis, and message-driven technologies such as MQTT.
* Contribute to frontend development using Vue 3 or React to support video management and operator-facing interfaces.
* Design and troubleshoot containerized services using Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm.
* Write technical design documents, make architectural decisions, review code, and guide engineering implementation.
* Develop automated unit and end-to-end tests, maintain CI workflows using GitHub Actions, and follow disciplined Git and pull-request practices.
* Use AI coding agents to support development efficiency while carefully reviewing and validating generated code.
* Collaborate with Engineering and product stakeholders to deliver reliable, scalable, and maintainable video solutions.

**What You Bring:**

* 7+ years of professional software development experience, including experience delivering and supporting at least one production software product.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience building video management systems (VMS), network video recorders (NVR), or video analytics products in production.
* Strong experience with video streaming protocols and standards, including RTSP/RTP, ONVIF Profile S, H.264/H.265, and MJPEG.
* Production experience developing video processing pipelines using GStreamer or FFmpeg.
* Strong programming experience with Rust, C++, or Go, with Rust preferred for media services.
* Experience designing scalable video recording and storage solutions, including continuous/event recording, retention policies, and cloud object storage.
* Knowledge of browser-based video streaming technologies such as WebCodecs, MSE, and WebRTC.
* Hands-on experience with computer vision, object detection, tracking, and GPU inference using ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, or similar technologies.
* Experience working with vision-language models and LLMs, including tool calling, structured outputs, local open models such as Qwen-VL, hosted APIs, and evaluation datasets.
* Strong backend development experience with Node.js and GraphQL APIs; TypeScript is a plus.
* Working proficiency with Vue 3 or React.
* Experience with MySQL, Redis, and message-driven or publish/subscribe systems such as MQTT.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and troubleshooting services in containerized environments.
* Strong Linux and networking fundamentals, including TCP/UDP, TLS, WebSockets, and packet capture analysis.
* Experience writing automated unit and end-to-end tests and working with GitHub Actions, Git, and pull-request workflows.
* Experience using AI coding agents, such as Claude Code, as part of daily development work, with the ability to review and correct generated code.
* Demonstrated ability to lead a small engineering team or technical workstream, make architectural decisions, and mentor developers.
* Strong problem-solving skills, technical ownership, and the ability to independently deliver solutions from design through production.
* Professional proficiency in spoken and written English.

**What You'll Gain:**

* A full-time, fully remote position with a growing international company.
* The opportunity to work on a mission-critical communication platform with real-world applications.
* Hands-on experience developing scalable real-time audio and networked communication solutions.
* Opportunities to collaborate with experienced engineers on complex software, networking, and embedded systems challenges.
* A collaborative remote working environment with an international engineering team.

**Location:** Remote LaTam

WebCreek is an equal opportunity employer. We believe our strength comes from our people and welcome all qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, color, gender, age, or disability. If you have the skills and the passion for tech, we want you on our team.

For more information, please visit: https://www.webcreek.com/

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and with a team. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Additional Experience Desired Familiarity with AWS AIDLC or a similar AI-driven development methodology. Experience building MCP servers or Claude skills. AWS Bedrock in production. Snowflake Cortex, dbt or semantic layer modelling. TypeScript in addition to Python. Integration experience with NetSuite, Salesforce, Zendesk or similar business systems. Automating finance, operations or customer support processes. Working in regulated or data-sensitive industries such as legal, financial services or healthcare. Experience with vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone) and Hugging Face. Good understanding of software engineering processes, and experience working with large datasets in production. Contributions to research papers, blogs or open-source projects. At 3Pillar, We Offer a World Of Opportunity Imagine a flexible work environment – whether it's the office, your home, or a blend of both. From interviews to onboarding, we embody a remote-first approach. You will be part of a global team , learning from top talent around the world and across cultures, speaking English everyday. Our global workforce enables our team to leverage global resources to accomplish our work in efficient and effective teams. ai-engineer._descripcion: We are seeking a highly skilled Senior LLM Engineer to join our innovative SaaS-based insurance mining platform. We have experienced record growth and are excited to grow the team. The ideal candidate will have industrial real world production expertise in fine-tuning large language models (LLMs), deep learning, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). This role requires hands-on experience with containerized workflows (e.g., Docker), Azure cloud services, and LLM optimization tools such as Unsloth, Lora and Qlora. You will be responsible for building, optimizing, and deploying models with large context windows to drive value for our insurance clients. This is direct hire role only no third parties or agencies. Candidates from Argentina, Pakistan and India encouraged to apply All Candidates will be required to take an automated test, followed by white board session. Candidate must be fluent to the highest level in written and spoken English language. This is a fully remote position. In order to be considered for this role: Candidate must have at least 4 years of experience with title ML Engineer or Data Scientist. Candidate must have 2 years continuous employment with the same employer Candidates must have completed a Stem related degree (not have one in progress) Recent grads are NOT a fit for this role. Key Responsibilities: 1. Model Development & Fine-tuning: Fine-tune and deploy large-scale LLMs (e.g., GPT, OPT, Llama, Falcon,Qwen) to extract insights from structured and unstructured insurance data (e.g., policy documents, claims data). Candidate must have experience with agentic AI with preference on Langchain/Langsmith Leverage transfer learning and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT) to optimize performance for specific tasks, such as document summarization and claims processing. Implement large-context-window models to handle long insurance documents, improving query accuracy in complex data extractions. 2. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Systems: Develop RAG pipelines to enhance LLM performance by integrating with external knowledge sources (e.g., Pinecone, FAISS, Azure Cognitive Search). Implement query encoding and embedding models for more accurate and contextual RAG queries. Optimize embedding-based document search for large insurance databases using vector databases. 3. Containerization & Cloud Deployment: Design and manage containerized environments using Docker and Docker Compose for reproducible training and inference workflows. Deploy and orchestrate LLMs in Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Azure Machine Learning (AML). Implement distributed training workflows for large LLMs using Azure Databricks, DeepSpeed, or Ray. 4. Model Performance & Monitoring: Monitor and improve the performance of LLM-based models (e.g., F1-score, perplexity, inference time) with tools such as Unsloth for efficient model evaluation and experimentation. Implement error analysis tools and automated retraining pipelines using MLOps best practices. Optimize for cost-efficiency and scalability in Azure cloud environments. 5. Collaboration & Stakeholder Communication: Collaborate with data engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver machine learning solutions tailored to client needs. Communicate complex findings and insights effectively through dashboards, reports, and presentations. Required Qualifications: Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, or a related field. A PhD is a plus. Experience: At least two years as data scientist, NLP engineer or MLOPS engineer in last role. 4+ years of experience in building and fine-tuning large language models (LLMs). Experience with deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) and libraries like Hugging Face Transformers. Hands-on experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS), and semantic search. Strong experience in containerized workflows using Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with Azure cloud services, including Azure Machine Learning (AML), Azure Blob Storage, and AKS. Strong Linux experience, shell scripting Technical Skills: Expert in Python. Familiarity with Unsloth or similar model evaluation frameworks for large LLM fine-tuning. Strong experience in embedding models (e.g., SentenceTransformers) and distributed training. Knowledge of MLOps frameworks (e.g., MLflow, Azure Pipelines) for versioning, monitoring, and model retraining. Preferred Qualifications: Experience working with insurance workflows (e.g., underwriting, claims analysis). Familiarity with long-document models (e.g., Llama2-Long, BigBird, or Memorizing Transformers, Qwen large models). Experience with low-rank fine-tuning (LoRA) and quantization techniques for efficient model deployment. Knowledge of Azure OpenAI Services for large-scale NLP applications. Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking. Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously. Effective communication and collaboration with cross-functional teams. About LineSlip Solutions: LineSlip has created a unique data visualization platform purpose-built for the commercial insurance industry that uses technology to automatically extract and organize data previously locked in binders, policies, proposals, and other insurance documents. With LineSlip Solutions, users can easily visualize data, automate reporting, and make smarter, more informed business decisions that affect the bottom line. We are actively working with some of the country’s most recognizable companies.

ai-engineer._descripcion:
AI Engineer

**AI** **Engineer (AI Platform & Data Engineering)**

**Location:** Remote, Spain Candidates must be based in Spain and have the existing right to work in Spain. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship or relocation support for this role

**Salary:** EUR 60,000–70,000 per annum (depending on experience)

**Overview of Position**

Speedcast delivers highly customizable, mission-critical communication solutions for remote sites worldwide. Our Data Engineering team operates a modern lakehouse platform — Kafka streaming, Iceberg on S3, a cloud query layer, and time-series databases on AWS — and we are building AI-powered products and internal tools on top of it.

As an AI Engineer on the platform side, you will build and operate the infrastructure that makes AI applications reliable in production: the data pipelines that feed them, the embedding and retrieval layers behind them, and the services, APIs, and monitoring around them. This role carries a strong data engineering component — you will cross-function with the wider team on platform duties, contributing to ingestion pipelines, data quality, and operational excellence across our data systems.

The successful candidate is a strong software and data engineer who is excited by the LLM application stack, cares about reliability, security, and cost, and is capable of working independently while collaborating closely with colleagues across Data Engineering, Data Science, and DevOps.

**What you will do**

  

* Design, build, and operate the pipelines that power AI applications: document and data ingestion, chunking and embedding pipelines, vector stores, and retrieval services.
* Productionize LLM-powered applications as reliable services: APIs, containerised deployments, observability, cost monitoring, and access control.
* Integrate AI workloads with the data lakehouse platform — streaming (Kafka) and batch sources, query layers, and time-series stores.
* Build and maintain evaluation, logging, and feedback infrastructure for AI applications in production.
* Contribute to core data engineering duties: developing and maintaining data pipelines, ensuring data quality and reliability, and improving platform performance and efficiency.
* Implement security, privacy, and governance best practices for AI systems handling company data.
* Collaborate with data scientists, AI engineers, software engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver AI-driven solutions.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, backlog grooming, sprint planning, and prioritisation activities.
* Evaluate and support the adoption of new AI platform technologies, tools, and architectural approaches.

**What we need from you**

  

* 3–5 years of experience in software engineering or data engineering, with hands-on exposure to AI/LLM application development.
* Commercial experience with Python and strong SQL skills (any major SQL dialect).
* Experience developing and maintaining data pipelines in production.
* Experience integrating foundation model APIs (e.g., Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI) into applications or services.
* Hands-on experience with AWS services (e.g., Lambda, Step Functions, S3, ECR, Glue) and AWS security best practices.
* Experience containerising applications using Docker.
* Experience building and operating APIs and backend services.
* Understanding of data quality, data governance, and data engineering best practices.
* Experience using Git for source control and working within Agile/Scrum environments.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Even better if you have**

  

* Experience with streaming platforms: Confluent Kafka, Avro/Schema Registry, Kafka Connect, or Apache Flink.
* Experience with lakehouse architectures: Apache Iceberg, Parquet, medallion patterns, and dbt.
* Experience with query engines such as Dremio and time-series databases such as TimescaleDB.
* Experience with vector search (pgvector or dedicated vector databases) and retrieval infrastructure at scale.
* Experience with agentic frameworks, tool use, or the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., CloudFormation, Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with cost monitoring and optimisation of cloud and AI workloads.
* Good understanding of GDPR and data governance principles.
* Advanced AWS expertise, including relevant AWS certifications.

**Working at Speedcast**

At Speedcast, we want people that like adventure. Who are motivated by work that takes uncommon ingenuity and thinking outside the box. Who relish the idea of working in an industry undergoing massive transformation. If you want to be part of a global team responsible for connecting the world, then you're in the right place.

We're always pushing forward, never standing still. When people rely on you and your team to stay connected, it brings everyone closer together. We're united by the adrenaline of high-stakes projects and our love of getting the job done right. You will experiment, learn and grow here, right alongside us, every single day.

Find great opportunities to make an impact. We have a "one team, one dream" mentality. We work together to make great things happen. Working at Speedcast isn't just a job, it's a career that you can take to new levels.

**Top reasons why people love working at Speedcast:**

  

* Our global presence – you get to work with clients and colleagues all over the world, in every continent
* Talented teammates – your co-workers are the best and brightest in the industry
* Industry leadership – be part of the latest advancements shaping the future of communications
* Ability to develop skills – work across departments to gain new skills and valuable experience
* Choose your environment – we have an environment to fit your temperament. Choose between a traditional desk job or work in the field.
* Grow your career – Guide your career in the direction you want. Gain new titles and responsibilities through our internal promotion system.
* Work on diverse projects – every day is different with our customers from a range of industries around the world

Build the Future of Data-Driven Mobility – from Barcelona

  

Volkswagen Group Services is excited to inform that Volkswagen Group Info Services AG and Volkswagen Digital:Hub are joining forces to create something new in Barcelona: a dedicated “GIS:Hub” with a clear focus on commercial B2B data business. This is more than a new innovative Hub. It is the start of a joint journey at the intersection of automotive expertise and digital innovation.

The GIS:Hub brings together the best of two worlds:
  

* Deep automotive and data expertise from Volkswagen Group Info Services.
* An agile, digital, hands-on environment from the Volkswagen Digital: Hub.

  

Together, we aim to advance the digital value creation across the entire vehicle life cycle.

  

Our culture:

* We are looking for pioneers – people who are excited to build, shape and grow something from the ground up. People who enjoy taking ownership, contributing ideas and turning concepts into real products with measurable business value.
* Our focus is on developing data-driven B2B products that create real impact for customers, partners and the Volkswagen ecosystem.
  

Where Automotive Meets Digital.

As a Senior AI Engineer you design, build, deploy and operate enterprise AI Agents with Azure Foundry and Databricks across different business departments like sales, legal, product management and operations.

  

We are looking for a motivated AI Engineer who combines strong software engineering skills with hands-on experience in Generative AI, Agentic AI, and cloud platforms (Azure, Databricks).
  
You are passionate about transforming business into an AI driven business and enjoy working at the intersection of technology, data, and business processes. Using AI to improve and automate the business internal and external processes.

**Responsibilities:**

  

* Design, build, and operate AI agents and AI applications using modern AI frameworks and LLMs. (Azure Foundry, Databricks)
* Integrate AI solutions with enterprise data platforms, APIs, and business applications.
* Passion for transforming business processes through AI and creating measurable business value.
* Develop monitoring and evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and quality.
* Understand and use GitHub CI/CD pipelines and AI engineering best practices for productive operations.
* Contribute to AI standards, reusable components, and engineering best practices.
* Ensure AI solutions meet security requirements.

**Requirements:**

  

* Hands-on experience designing, building, and operating AI applications and AI Agents in enterprise environments.
* Strong expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and modern AI frameworks.
* Proven experience with Azure AI Foundry, Databricks, and cloud-native AI solutions.
* Solid software engineering background with strong programming skills in Python.
* Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise platforms, APIs, databases, and business applications.
* Understanding of GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and AI engineering best practices.
* Knowledge of AI evaluation, monitoring, and quality assurance frameworks.
* Analytical mindset, structured working style, and strong problem-solving skills.
* Academic degree in Information Science, Computer Science, Business Informatics, Data Science, or a comparable qualification.
* Fluent in English & Spanish

Join us at GIS:HUB to advance your career in a role where your administrative skills will directly contribute to the success and smooth operation of our innovative projects.

ai-engineer._descripcion:
About FullStack

FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence.

We’re Most Proud Of



- Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas.
- Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies.
- Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users.
- Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor.
- Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average.

The Opportunity

Join our talent network and connect with U.S. clients for flexible, project-based development work as an AI Machine Learning Engineer.



- You will integrate directly into our client's team and work alongside their existing designers and engineers on a daily basis.

What We're Looking For



- 4+ years of professional experience as an Artificial Intelligence Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, or similar role.
- Advanced English is required.
- Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required.
- Proven experience developing and optimizing AI/ML models using Python and frameworks like LangChain.
- Deep understanding of large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and the latest trends in generative AI.
- Hands-on experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) techniques and vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate).
- Solid experience integrating and deploying AI/ML solutions into production environments.
- Ability to design and maintain scalable, reliable AI infrastructure on cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
- Strong skills in documenting AI/ML workflows, architectural decisions, and best practices.
- Experience with MLOps, CI/CD pipelines, and maintaining production-grade AI systems.
- Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed.
- Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications.
- Forensic attention to detail.
- A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.
- Experience working on Agile / Scrum teams.
- Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems.
- Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon.
- Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients, and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them.
- Ability to consistently work 40 hours per week. 

Work Authorization Requirements



- Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country of this job posting on a full-time basis.
- FullStack will not sponsor applicants for work visas now or in the future.

What We Offer



- Competitive pay.
- 100% remote work.
- The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies.
- Continuing education opportunities.
- Opportunity to grow and expand your career.

We welcome individuals of all races, religions, genders, sexual orientations, national origins, abilities, and experiences. Our focus is on connecting talent with projects based on qualifications, ensuring a fair and transparent process that values diverse perspectives and global collaboration.

* Asumir la responsabilidad de las iniciativas de diseño de principio a fin.

* Capacidad para combinar excelencia visual, usabilidad y visión de producto.
* Iniciativa para proponer nuevas ideas y detectar oportunidades de mejora.
* Experiencia incorporando IA en procesos creativos y de desarrollo.
* Interés por los retos tecnológicos relacionados con networking y troubleshooting.
* Orientación a resultados, autonomía y atención al detalle.

product-designer._descripcion: About Livo Livo is building the AI-powered operating system for the healthcare workforce. We operate at the intersection of HR Tech, marketplaces, and applied AI, tackling one of healthcare’s hardest problems: enabling hospitals to plan, staff, and operate their workforce effectively. By putting clinicians first, we help nurses and doctors focus on what truly matters—patient care. We are a fast-scaling company where advanced AI meets real-world impact. The Role We're looking for a Product Designer with strong technical chops and AI fluency to join our team in Barcelona. The era of static wireframe → mockup → handoff is over. We need someone who understands that AI is reshaping how products are designed and built , and who actively uses AI tools to accelerate their workflow — from generative prototyping and code-assisted design to leveraging LLMs for research synthesis and rapid exploration. You'll sit at the intersection of design, engineering, and AI — working cross-product, shipping features that are beautifully designed and technically sound. You're equally comfortable in Figma, in a React codebase, and prompting an AI to generate a first draft you can refine. What You'll Do Own the end-to-end design process using AI-augmented workflows from research to production-ready components Contribute to our design system (React + Storybook) Use AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, v0) daily for code generation, prototyping, and research synthesis Partner with PMs and engineers to define problems, explore solutions, and ship iteratively Conduct user research and usability testing, augmented by AI Create responsive, accessible interfaces across devices What We're Looking For Design 3+ years of experience as a Product Designer (ideally with strong engineering skills) in tech Strong portfolio showing end-to-end work (research → ship) Experience with design systems — building and maintaining them Technical Comfortable writing React components — production-quality, not just prototypes Experience with Storybook, Git/GitHub workflows, and responsive/accessible web development AI & Modern Workflow You actively use AI-powered tools (Cursor, v0, Claude, Codex) as a genuine multiplier — not a gimmick You understand where AI adds real value vs. where human judgment is essential You stay current with the AI-design landscape and bring new tools to the team Mindset Systems thinker. Comfortable with ambiguity. Ships fast. High-autonomy profile: proactively identifies opportunities, defines scope, and drives work from idea to shipped outcome with minimal oversight Builds product intimacy: invests in deeply understanding our users and domain, develops strong product intuition, and acts as a long-term steward of quality and coherence Not precious about "the old way" — if AI does it better, you embrace it Clear communicator in both Spanish and English Nice to Have Experience in HR tech, SaaS, or B2B products Experience designing AI-powered features (conversational UI, predictive interfaces) Contributions to open-source design systems or component libraries What We Offer Competitive salary + equity On-site in Barcelona with a world class and multidisciplinary team that want to win Real ownership — your work shapes products used by thousands of healthcare professionals

product-designer._descripcion: About Sezzle: With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping! About the Role: We are seeking a talented and motivated Product Design Intern who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ and. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. Also someone who’s excited to learn, experiment, and help shape the future of Sezzle’s web and mobile experiences. If you love crafting intuitive interfaces, have an eye for motion and micro-interactions, and are curious about where AI meets design, you’ll fit right in. You’ll work closely with product managers, engineers, and designers to ship thoughtful, user-centric work that makes people’s lives easier. What You'll Do: Partner with product managers and engineers to design user-friendly features across Sezzle’s platforms Create wireframes, visual designs, prototypes, and interaction flows that balance clarity, aesthetics, and usability Contribute to our design system by building and documenting reusable components in Figma Ensure consistency of design & UI patterns, language, and branding elements across all product components Participate in user research and testing to inform and refine your work Present design work and rationale to design team and stakeholders while gathering feedback to iterate and polish your solutions Explore illustration, motion design, and micro-interactions to elevate the experience What We Look For: Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Human-Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, or a related field Some hands-on experience in UI/UX or product design for digital products (through internships, coursework, freelance, or personal projects) Strong communication skills in English Proficiency in Figma for interface design and prototyping Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication. Familiarity with modern product design trends and basic design principles Experience: Some prior exposure to designing for web or mobile (internships, freelance, coursework, or personal projects count) Craft & Tools: Strong Figma skills for interface design and prototyping; curiosity about testing and validating with users User Focus: Passion for building accessible, inclusive experiences Design Systems: Understanding of scalable UI systems, from color and typography tokens to components Component Management: Experience creating and updating UI components in Figma Adaptability: Comfortable juggling multiple projects and deadline while maintaining quality Collaboration: Clear communicator and team player who’s open to feedback Technical Bonus: Familiarity with HTML/CSS/React is a plus, not a requirement Portfolio Requirements: Please include a link to an online portfolio or PDF that showcases: 3-4 of your best digital design projects Clear explanation of problem and project requirements Your design process Preferred Qualifications: Experience with animation or motion tools (After Effects, Lottie, Rive) Interest in designing interactive components and motion-enhanced micro-interactions Curiosity about how AI can support and accelerate the design process About You: You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking. You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully. You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly. You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle. What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome: At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire. Compensation : The salary for the Product Design Intern is $800 USD monthly gross as an independent contractor. #Li-remote #Full-time

product-designer._descripcion:
**Descripción breve - externa**
-------------------------------

¡Haz historia en la democratización del comercio y de los servicios financieros, transformando la vida de millones de personas en América Latina con Mercado Libre!

Diseña experiencias integrales de facturación e impuestos, conectando investigación, diseño visual y contenido para convertir problemas de producto en flujos claros y completos desde la definición hasta la implementación.

**Desafíos:**

* Investigar problemas junto con Producto y Negocio, cuestionar los pedidos cuando sea necesario y convertir los hallazgos en oportunidades de diseño.
* Explorar alternativas, crear prototipos rápidos y validar soluciones con usuarios; diseñar flujos completos, incluidos los casos de error y las situaciones límite.
* Definir la jerarquía de mensajes, redactar textos y establecer la terminología de las experiencias; aplicar el sistema de diseño Andes y cuidar cada detalle visual hasta la implementación.
* Presentar y defender propuestas con fundamentos, facilitar sesiones de alineación e incorporar herramientas de IA en las distintas etapas del proceso de diseño.

**Experiencia y conocimientos:**

* Aprender con agilidad en base a desafíos, potenciándote con tecnología y GenAI.
* Apasionarse por salir de la zona de confort, dar el máximo, superar los propios límites y emprender en un ambiente sano, alegre y divertido.
* Contar con 3 a 5 años de experiencia en diseño de producto, experiencia de usuario o disciplinas similares, idealmente en productos digitales a escala, y diseñar flujos de punta a punta que contemplen errores y situaciones límite.
* Dominar Figma avanzado, los principios visuales y el trabajo con sistemas de diseño, y cuidar el detalle visual hasta la implementación.
* Comunicarse en español; redactar textos de interfaz y narrativas para presentar el trabajo; usar herramientas de IA en el día a día para investigar, idear, prototipar o escribir y explicar su aplicación; tomar posición y fundamentar decisiones con autonomía, sin supervisión constante.

Conoce más sobre nuestra cultura y negocio en nuestro Career Site.  
¡Lo mejor está llegando!  
*Híbrido*

product-designer._descripcion: About BEES Join us to build the future of B2B commerce! BEES is AB InBev’s B2B platform. Through our ecosystem, merchants and retailers across 29 countries can stock their businesses quickly, easily, and securely. At BEES, we dream big, lead with purpose, and develop technology that transforms the way retailers and sellers grow. Every line of code and every partnership is built in service of a single mission: to make commerce better for retailers and sellers around the world. Here, your work is not just important. It makes a difference! About the role We are hiring a Senior Product Designer, Design Systems to help create, evolve, and maintain Hexa , BEES’s global design system for mobile and web products around the world. You will sit where design, design operations, and front-end implementation meet. In Figma, you will define how components look and behave. You will write specs that engineering can build from, work closely with teams shipping hexa and mobile libraries, and help more squads adopt the system through clear documentation, enablement, and measurable results. This role suits you if you think of systems, care about detail at the token and component level, and want your work to land in production code , not only in design files. You will join experienced designers and engineers in an agile setup, with real influence on roadmap, governance, and how we use AI to deliver design systems to work faster and more consistently. What you’ll do Own Hexa’s evolution. Lead discovery, design, and iteration on components, patterns, and foundations (tokens, typography, icons), and keep libraries aligned as the system grows. Design for implementation. Write clear component specs: states, variants, accessibility, and content rules. Keep Figma libraries in sync with shipped engineering libraries . Partner with engineering. Act as a go-to design contact through office hours, unblocking work, aligning on APIs and props, checking build quality, and supporting component PRs and releases. Documentation and enablement. Improve centralized documentation and take part in enablement (for example Hexa Connect-style workshops and engineering updates) so teams use the system the right way. Measure adoption. Help define and use KPIs and dashboards for library usage, quality, and consistency, and use that data to prioritize the backlog and close gaps between design and development. Support product squads. Advise Hexa-aligned solutions, coordinate system updates with large initiatives, and balance platform consistency with squad deadlines. Use AI thoughtfully. Apply tools such as Cursor and Figma MCP to speed up specs, audits, prototypes, and internal tooling, and help mature agentic workflows for component work where they add lasting value. Collaborate and influence. Work with product, engineering, and design leadership on roadmap and governance; run critiques and working sessions when teams need to align. Advocate for quality. Push for accessibility, inclusive language, and consistent experience across BEES while respecting business and platform constraints. What we’re looking for Senior design systems experience. You have shipped and maintained a multi-platform design system (components, tokens, documentation, versioning) in a product organization at scale. Design technologist mindset. You are comfortable reading front-end code (for example React, TypeScript, CSS or Tailwind, and component props). You do not need to be a full-time engineer, but you should discuss tradeoffs with engineering and contribute meaningfully to PR reviews. Expert Figma skills. You work confidently with variables and tokens, component properties, variants, auto-layout, and libraries, and you produce specs engineers can implement without guesswork. Clear communication in English. You explain system decisions, migration impact, and adoption plans to designers, engineers, and leadership. Cross-functional delivery. You have partnered with platform or foundation teams and product squads, using iteration and both qualitative and quantitative feedback. Systems thinking with hands-on delivery. You can set direction and still ship precise component updates on a quarterly cadence. Practical use of AI. You already use AI in your day-to-day work and look for repeatable ways to help the team (specs, docs, audits, prototypes), not one-off experiments. Comfort with parallel work. Design system work mixes components, support, documentation, and metrics at the same time; you keep quality high across all of it. Bonus points Not required, but they help you stand out: Hands-on work on component libraries in code (monorepo packages, Storybook, design token pipelines). Code Connect or similar practices that keep Figma and code aligned. E-commerce or B2B SaaS , including mobile consumer apps and desktop admin or back-office tools. Global products and design systems that account for localization. Design system analytics (adoption, version drift, usage or bundle metrics). AI-assisted design or development pipelines for UI components. Please be prepared to submit Your resume An updated portfolio (file or link), including at least one design system case (components, tokens, documentation, and how you worked with engineering) A live presentation of a product or design system case and prototype during interviews What We Offer: Performance based bonus* Attendance Bonus* Private pension plan Meal Allowance Casual office and dress code Days off* Health, dental, and life insurance Medicines discounts WellHub partnership Childcare subsidies Discounts on Ambev products* Clube Ben partnership Scholarship* School materials assurance Language and training platforms Transport allowance *Rules applied Equal Opportunity & Affirmative Action: AB InBev Growth Group is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon of race, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. The following fields are optional, but anticipate the information for your registration*. Remember: your data will never be used as elimination criteria in selection processes. With them, AB InBev Growth Group is able to analyze diversity and reduce biases in selection processes. We want to contribute to changing this reality by being an inclusive company. For more information: www.abinbev.com
