product-designer._descripcion:
O Itaú é a marca mais valiosa do Brasil, a melhor empresa para trabalhar segundo o Great Place to Work e o maior banco da América Latina. Nós impactamos diariamente mais de 98 milhões de clientes em 18 países.

Somos feitos de pessoas e acreditamos que ter um time com pluralidade de origens, culturas, crenças, experiências, raças, deficiências, gêneros, orientações afetivo-sexuais e gerações ampliam as perspectivas e contribuem para um clima de respeito e valorização das diferenças.

  
  
**Responsabilidades e atribuições**

O **CRM** atua na interseção entre **design de experiência, estratégia de relacionamento e sistemas inteligentes de decisão**, criando jornadas contínuas e personalizadas ao longo do ciclo de vida do cliente.

Com a incorporação do perfil de **Staff Designer**, essa posição evolui de uma atuação focada apenas em jornadas e automações para um papel também **estratégico, transversal e organizacional**, influenciando múltiplos times, produtos e decisões de negócio.

O que você irá fazer:

* Desenhar e evoluir **sistemas de relacionamento com o cliente ponta a ponta**, cobrindo perfil e cadastro, ativação, retenção e reengajamento
* Criar experiências personalizadas baseadas em dados, segmentação e IA (LLMs e modelos preditivos)
* Identificar **problemas estruturais de jornada e experiência**, mesmo quando não há demanda formal ou roadmap definido (navegando ambiguidade como Staff)
* Atuar diretamente na **formulação de estratégia de produto e CRM**, influenciando priorização com base em impacto de negócio (receita, risco e retenção)
* Trabalhar de forma transversal entre múltiplos squads, quebrando silos e conectando experiências fragmentadas
* Projetar sistemas de comunicação multicanal (push, e-mail, in-app, mensageria) como parte de um **ecossistema contínuo de relacionamento**
* Traduzir dados comportamentais e sinais de cliente em **decisões de experiência e regras de produto**
* Liderar iniciativas de alto impacto com autonomia, do conceito à implementação, garantindo qualidade de ponta a ponta
* Atuar em parceria próxima com Produto, Growth, Dados e Engenharia para estruturar soluções escaláveis e mensuráveis

  
  
  
  
**Requisitos e qualificações**  

* **Design de Produto / Product Design**

* **IA aplicada a produtos e experiências**

* Capacidade de atuar de forma hands-on

* Liderança/influência técnica

* Gestão de stakeholders

* Autonomia e ownership

* Capacidade de operar entre estratégia e execução  
    
  Diferenciais
* Experiência com **Growth / CRM**.

* Vivência com personalização, engajamento ou jornadas orientadas por dados.

* Conhecimento técnico de **front-end**.

* Experiência em ambientes digitais de alta escala.

* Liderança de designers ou desenvolvimento técnico de profissionais.

  
  
  
  
**Informações adicionais**

**Ao se tornar um ituber você tem\_**

* Vale-Transporte
* Vale-Refeição (Restaurantes) / Vale-Alimentação (Supermercados)
* Plano médico (Fundação Saúde Itaú **ou** Central Nacional Unimed)
* Plano odontológico (Odontoprev **ou** Interodonto)
* Seguro de Vida
* PLR – Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (Mediante resultados do banco)
* Previdência privada
* Descontos exclusivos em nossos produtos financeiros
* Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida
* Auxílio Creche / Babá (para papais e mamães)
* Incentivo a estudos
* Wellhub ou TotalPass
* Acesso aos Clubes de Lazer Itaú (Guarapiranga / Itanhaém e São Sebastião)
* + Algumas vantagens que você pode conhecer durante o processo

Conheça mais sobre nossa cultura: https://www.itau.com.br/relacoes-com-investidores/noticias/cultura-itubers-e-nosso-novo-conjunto-de-valores/

* Estimulamos candidaturas de pessoas com deficiência em todas as nossas posições, sendo assim, sinta-se à vontade para se candidatar em vagas sinalizadas como exclusivas ou não para pessoas com deficiência. Somos comprometidos com a inclusão e valorizamos a diversidade.

**#VemProItaú #VemSerItuber**

**Somos o Itaú Unibanco**, o maior banco privado da América Latina e a marca mais valiosa do Brasil. Há oito anos consecutivos, estamos entre as empresas que mais impulsionam carreiras no país, segundo o LinkedIn Top Companies.

Com cerca de **90 mil Itubers** e presença em **18 países**, trabalhamos todos os dias para transformar a vida de milhões de pessoas por meio de soluções financeiras que geram impacto real. Aqui, você encontra a oportunidade de desenvolver sua carreira em um ambiente que combina propósito, inovação e protagonismo.

Investimos continuamente em **tecnologia, dados, inteligência artificial e desenvolvimento de pessoas**, acelerando a evolução dos nossos negócios e preparando nossos profissionais para os desafios do futuro. Para isso, contamos com iniciativas de capacitação de ponta e parcerias com instituições de referência mundial.

Nossa cultura é movida por aprendizado, colaboração e alta performance. Somos reconhecidos pelos nossos programas de desenvolvimento, pelo compromisso com a sustentabilidade e por criar um ambiente onde as pessoas podem crescer e gerar impacto. Somos o único banco da América Latina presente no Índice Dow Jones de Sustentabilidade desde sua criação, destaque no ranking **Lugares Mais Incríveis para Trabalhar 2025 (Estadão/FIA)** e eleitos, pela décima vez consecutiva, como a **marca mais valiosa do Brasil**, segundo a Brand Finance.

product-designer._descripcion: Job Description Why GMF? GM Financial International Operations conducts business in Latin America and China. International Operations offers a wide range of wholesale and retail automotive financing products to dealers and their customers. The strength of the international business lies in its ability to tailor its products to meet unique dealer needs, consumer preferences and national requirements in local markets. Latin American country operations include Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico, and Peru. Responsibilities About the Role The Digital Product Management team within International Operations (IO) Customer Experience is seeking a Lead Product Designer who is passionate about creating exceptional digital experiences and optimizing interfaces to enhance customer satisfaction. This role will be part of a strategic, multi-year transformation focused on modernizing GM Financial’s servicing platform and shaping the future of how we serve our customers. The initiative brings together business, technology, data and customer experience teams to deliver simpler, more scalable and innovative capabilities, leveraging product and service design, automation and AI. Team members will have the opportunity to contribute to a high-impact transformation, collaborate across functions and markets, and help build capabilities that create lasting value for our customers and the business. You will serve as the hands-on Lead Product Designer for the future servicing experience, executing design work across the transformation. Under the guidance of the Product Lead, you will take work from early discovery and process reimagination through detailed experience design and delivery, including research, journey and process design, user flows, wireframes, prototypes and interaction design. You will work closely with Operational Excellence and cross-functional partners across Product, Technology, Data and the business to translate future servicing processes into simple, intuitive experiences. You will be a key advocate for the customer and user, continuously bringing their needs, feedback and perspectives into product and design decisions throughout the transformation. In This Role You Will Shape and execute the UX vision for the future servicing experience, translating transformation objectives and user needs into simple, cohesive experiences. Lead hands-on design from discovery through delivery and iteration, including journey and process design, user flows, wireframes, prototypes and detailed experience design. Partner with Product, Operational Excellence, Technology and other cross-functional teams to reimagine servicing processes, translating complex user, business and operational needs into effective experience solutions. Bring the voice of customers and users into product and design decisions through research, prototyping and user testing to understand needs, validate assumptions and refine solutions. Facilitate design and problem-solving workshops to align cross-functional teams, explore opportunities and move complex experience decisions forward. Present and advocate for design recommendations, clearly articulating customer evidence, design rationale and trade-offs behind key experience decisions. Apply and contribute to design systems and experience standards, creating consistent and scalable experiences across products, journeys and markets. Use customer feedback, behavioral data and experience measures to evaluate outcomes and identify opportunities to improve the experience. Qualifications What makes you an ideal candidate? Strong analytical skills to interpret user data, customer feedback and UX metrics and translate insights into design improvements. Excellent communication and collaboration skills across diverse teams and stakeholders. Strong understanding of user research principles, with experience conducting usability testing and translating findings into design decisions. Deep understanding of interaction and visual design principles. Ability to create journey maps, process flows, user flows, wireframes, mockups and interactive prototypes using tools such as Figma, Sketch or Adobe XD. Ability to understand complex business requirements, user needs and technical constraints and translate them into intuitive design solutions. Experience working in Agile or Scrum product development environments. Skilled in presenting complex design concepts and clearly articulating design decisions and trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences. Understanding of UX metrics, A/B testing and performance analysis to evaluate and continuously improve experiences. Fluency in English; Spanish and/or Portuguese is a plus. Additional Knowledge And Skills Working effectively within an AI enabled environment: Ability to use AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot) to support daily work Skills in evaluating AI outputs for accuracy, compliance, and bias Experience integrating AI into workflows to improve efficiency or insights Familiarity with AI assisted research, summarization, and content generation Understanding of responsible AI use, including ethics and data protection Experience & Education 7+ years of experience in Product Design, UX Design, UI/Visual Design, UX Research or related roles. Proven ability to lead UX initiatives and design projects from discovery through delivery and iteration. Bachelor’s degree in UX Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Design or a related field. At GM Financial we want you to be the most authentic version of yourself. We take care of your work-life balance by programming wellness and integration activities , where you will strengthen your relationships with peers and contribute towards the development and wellbeing of your community , while providing you with a competitive salary and benefits . ##### **Buscamos Product Designer**

En Nonconformist, somos una agencia de experiencias y productos digitales.

Nos enfocamos en el diseño centrado en las personas, con un enfoque multidisciplinar que abarca todo el proceso de creación de valor. Combinamos Diseño, Data, Growth y Tecnología para transformar negocios, proporcionando soluciones end-to-end que impactan directamente en la experiencia del usuario.

### **El desafío**

Buscamos **Product Designer** para trabajar en productos digitales, dentro de un entorno bancario, colaborando con squads multidisciplinarios y stakeholders diversos. El rol requiere capacidad de diseño end-to-end, criterio para priorizar, y madurez para tomar decisiones informadas por datos, negocio y experiencia de usuario, en contextos donde no todo está dado ni resuelto. El cliente para el cual trabajarás es del rubro banca y, posee un esquema de **presencialidad de 3 veces a la semana**, en su oficina ubicada en Puerto Madero, por lo que es necesario que vivas en Capital Federal o alrededores.

##### **️Qué vas a hacer en el día a día**

* Trabajar en conjunto con **producto, desarrollo y otros diseñadores** para idear, validar e implementar soluciones.
* Diseñar **experiencias digitales** considerando interacción, usabilidad, accesibilidad y consistencia con el ecosistema existente.
* Participar activamente en **instancias de discovery**: research exploratorio, entrevistas, benchmarks y análisis de oportunidades.
* Diseñar **journeys, flujos y arquitecturas de información**, con una mirada integral del producto y sus distintos puntos de contacto.
* Crear **wireframes, mockups y prototipos interactivos**, siguiendo lineamientos del cliente y proponiendo mejoras cuando el contexto lo permita.
* Planificar y ejecutar **tests con personas usuarias**, analizando métricas y resultados para iterar sobre las soluciones.
* Tomar y defender **decisiones de diseño basadas en dato**s, criterios de éxito y objetivos del negocio.
* Trabajar con **Design Systems**, utilizando componentes existentes, proponiendo nuevos y colaborando en su validación y evolución.
* Asegurar el **handoff y seguimiento con desarrollo**, acompañando la implementación para mantener la calidad de la experiencia.
* Colaborar con el equipo en la **mejora continua de la práctica de diseño** y el intercambio de aprendizajes.

### **Qué esperamos de vos**

* Experiencia de **+3 años** en Product Design, UX/UI o roles similares.
* Experiencia previa diseñando **productos digitales para banca empresa, fintech, seguros** o productos de complejidad similar.
* Conocimiento sólido de **usabilidad, diseño centrado en las personas y accesibilidad**.
* Experiencia trabajando con **metodologías ágiles** (Scrum, Kanban u otras).
* Capacidad para priorizar, estimar esfuerzo y ajustar el nivel de detalle según objetivos y contexto.
* Autonomía para organizar tu trabajo y colaborar activamente con el equipo.
* Capacidad para recibir feedback y flexibilidad para cambios de prioridades.
* Buen manejo de herramientas de diseño y prototipado (Figma principalmente).
* Diseñar involucrándose en la implementación.
* Capacidad de negociación para llegar a acuerdos con el cliente.

### **Valoramos especialmente**

* Capacidad para formular buenas preguntas, no solo buenas pantallas.
* Mirada crítica para equilibrar calidad, tiempo y esfuerzo.
* Interés en métricas de uso, conversión y adopción.
* Personas que entienden el diseño como una práctica colaborativa.

**Cómo trabajamos en Nonconformist**

Nos gusta trabajar con personas que:

* Son autónomas y responsables;, saben gestionar sus responsabilidades y su tiempo.

product-designer._descripcion: Job Description Why GMF? GM Financial International Operations conducts business in Latin America and China. International Operations offers a wide range of wholesale and retail automotive financing products to dealers and their customers. The strength of the international business lies in its ability to tailor its products to meet unique dealer needs, consumer preferences and national requirements in local markets. Latin American country operations include Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico, and Peru. Responsibilities About the Role The Digital Product Management team within International Operations (IO) Customer Experience is seeking a Lead Product Designer who is passionate about creating exceptional digital experiences and optimizing interfaces to enhance customer satisfaction. This role will be part of a strategic, multi-year transformation focused on modernizing GM Financial’s servicing platform and shaping the future of how we serve our customers. The initiative brings together business, technology, data and customer experience teams to deliver simpler, more scalable and innovative capabilities, leveraging product and service design, automation and AI. Team members will have the opportunity to contribute to a high-impact transformation, collaborate across functions and markets, and help build capabilities that create lasting value for our customers and the business. You will serve as the hands-on Lead Product Designer for the future servicing experience, executing design work across the transformation. Under the guidance of the Product Lead, you will take work from early discovery and process reimagination through detailed experience design and delivery, including research, journey and process design, user flows, wireframes, prototypes and interaction design. You will work closely with Operational Excellence and cross-functional partners across Product, Technology, Data and the business to translate future servicing processes into simple, intuitive experiences. You will be a key advocate for the customer and user, continuously bringing their needs, feedback and perspectives into product and design decisions throughout the transformation. In This Role You Will Shape and execute the UX vision for the future servicing experience, translating transformation objectives and user needs into simple, cohesive experiences. Lead hands-on design from discovery through delivery and iteration, including journey and process design, user flows, wireframes, prototypes and detailed experience design. Partner with Product, Operational Excellence, Technology and other cross-functional teams to reimagine servicing processes, translating complex user, business and operational needs into effective experience solutions. Bring the voice of customers and users into product and design decisions through research, prototyping and user testing to understand needs, validate assumptions and refine solutions. Facilitate design and problem-solving workshops to align cross-functional teams, explore opportunities and move complex experience decisions forward. Present and advocate for design recommendations, clearly articulating customer evidence, design rationale and trade-offs behind key experience decisions. Apply and contribute to design systems and experience standards, creating consistent and scalable experiences across products, journeys and markets. Use customer feedback, behavioral data and experience measures to evaluate outcomes and identify opportunities to improve the experience. Qualifications What makes you an ideal candidate? Excellent communication and collaboration skills across diverse teams and stakeholders. Ability to create journey maps, process flows, user flows, wireframes, mockups and interactive prototypes using tools such as Figma, Sketch or Adobe XD. Experience working in Agile or Scrum product development environments. product-designer._descripcion: Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others. Product Designer, Design Systems About the role As a Product Designer at Clara, you’ll own Prism, our design system: the foundations, patterns and guidance that let designers, engineers, PMs and AI agents ship consistent, high-quality products. This is a hands-on builder role that reports to the Head of Design. You don’t need an engineering title, but you prototype in code, open pull requests, wire up agents and run evals without waiting on anyone. Senior engineers own the design system’s architecture; you own what it should be and make it happen. Responsibilities Own Prism’s design on web and mobile: foundations, tokens, components and patterns, working with the engineers who maintain the library. Turn Clara’s design principles into guidance on when to use each pattern, for which user and why, for both people and AI agents. Define the mobile pattern layer. We build with native components; you decide where we follow the platform and where Clara diverges. Scale the agentic layer. Extend the skills, context files and agent workflows we already use so anyone at Clara can go from idea to on-system UI and pull requests. Set the bar and test against it: evals and automated checks for components and AI-generated output, covering accessibility, visual regression and token compliance. Use models to benchmark Prism against the best systems and close the gaps. Run the system like a product. Own contribution, versioning and releases with engineering, and decide what becomes a system pattern, what stays local and what gets deprecated. Measure adoption and speed, and remove what slows product teams down. Who you are 5+ years in product design, including building a design system and driving its adoption. You can show both the architecture and the results. Senior judgment on system decisions: you have made calls that affected many teams, and can explain the trade-offs. Strong design craft. You can tell when something on-system is still not good. You build with AI every day. With tools like Claude Code or Codex, you make changes in a component codebase and open pull requests an engineer would take seriously. You have built AI tooling others rely on: agents, skills, evals or multi-step workflows, not just prompts. Deep knowledge of Apple’s Human Interface Guidelines and Material Design, and experience defining patterns for native apps. An operations mindset: process, metrics, governance and documentation. Professional English: you can present your work, run a session and write documentation in English. Nice to haves Experience in fintech or B2B products with complex, data-heavy UI. Multi-brand or multi-market systems, including localization. Having led or supported a migration from one component library to another. Basic experience with Swift or Kotlin, enough to prototype and review implementation. Experience with CI, GitHub Actions or visual regression tooling. Where we work This is a hybrid role: you'll split your time between the office, customers and home. We don't set a minimum number of office days for most roles — you'll spend time in the office naturally, and most days during your ramp-up or when your leader asks. Why Clara A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership. Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one. An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths. English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day. How we work Clarity — Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters. Simplicity — If it can be simpler, it should be. Ownership — We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait. Pride — We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver. ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning. Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara. If you meet the must-haves, apply — the nice-to-haves are a bonus, not a requirement.

product-designer._descripcion:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK
  
  
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
  
  
You’ll join our Technology Services Group team in GBS Warsaw. This team supports Bain’s global business through technology products and services that help our teams work more effectively and deliver impact for clients. You’ll collaborate with colleagues across functions, geographies, and seniority levels, partnering closely with product owners, engineering teams, senior stakeholders, vendors, Legal, Risk, Procurement, and other technology teams
  
  
WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM
  
  
The Design Lead is a senior leader, whose mission is to drive better and faster results for Bain consultants and clients through AI-powered digital products embedded in Bain’s consulting solutions. In this role, the Design Lead shapes product and experience strategy across complex workstreams, translating customer, business, product/data, and evolving AI capabilities into cohesive experience direction and partnering with senior Product, Engineering, AI/ML, and business stakeholders to influence product vision, roadmap, prioritization, and investment decisions.
  
The Design Lead applies deep functional and technical design expertise to advise on complex strategic issues, guide designers responsible for execution, and determine where and how AI can create meaningful user and business value. The Design Lead plays a significant leadership role across the product, builds relationships across the organization, and may be responsible for the management, professional development, and coaching of other designers.
  
  
Principal Accountabilities
  
  
Product & Design Strategy (50%)
  

* Shape product and experience strategy across complex workstreams, translating business objectives, customer needs, product/data strategy, and evolving AI capabilities into a cohesive long-term direction.
* Partner with senior Product, Engineering, AI/ML, and business stakeholders to influence product vision, roadmap, prioritization, and investment decisions.
* Determine where and how AI capabilities can create meaningful user and business value, establishing experience principles for human-agent interaction, transparency, trust, uncertainty, and appropriate human oversight.
* Guide design across concurrent workstreams to ensure coherence, scalability, and measurable product impact.

Research, Discovery & Product Direction (20%)
  

* Establish discovery and research strategy for complex or ambiguous product opportunities, ensuring evidence informs product strategy and investment decisions.
* Synthesize user research, product data, business context, and technical/AI capabilities into clear strategic recommendations.
* Facilitate senior stakeholder discussions and working sessions to align teams around opportunities, trade-offs, priorities, and product direction.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Product Impact (20%)
  

* Serve as a trusted thought partner to senior Product, Engineering, AI/ML, and business leaders on complex product, experience, and AI-related decisions.
* Orchestrate design across teams and workstreams, resolving dependencies and guiding designers responsible for detailed execution.
* Influence scope and sequencing to focus teams on the highest-value outcomes while maintaining long-term product coherence.

Design Capability & Team Leadership (10%
  

* Manage and develop designers where applicable, providing strategic direction, coaching, and oversight while enabling independent execution.
* Establish and scale reusable standards, design system patterns, and human-agent interaction patterns that improve quality and delivery efficiency.
* Contribute leadership beyond the immediate product by sharing expertise, developing capability, and advancing effective AI-enabled product design practices.

ABOUT YOU
  
  
Knowledge, Skills, Abilities
  
  

* Recognized expertise in product design strategy, systems, and emerging technologies, with deep understanding of how AI is changing product experiences, development practices, and the role of Design.
* Exceptional strategic and systems thinking; rapidly synthesizes complex business, technical, data, and AI context to identify opportunities, risks, and broader organizational implications.
* Demonstrates strong organizational judgment across competing priorities, dependencies, capacity, and investment needs, balancing near-term outcomes with long-term product direction.
* Proven leadership capability, including developing senior talent, setting a high bar for quality and judgment, and providing direction across complex teams and workstreams.
* Anticipates shifts in AI and product development and translates them into scalable capabilities, standards, and ways of working that strengthen the broader team.

Experience
  
  

* Associate’s/Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
* 8-10 years of relevant experience in product design, technology, or a related field.
* Extensive product design leadership experience across highly complex products or interconnected workstreams, including teams delivering AI/ML-enabled features or products.
* Significant experience shaping product and experience strategy, ideally including AI- or data-driven products.
* Experience leading and developing designers; direct management experience preferred.
* Experience with complex software and/or digital products in the B2B or B2C space, including AI-powered products.
* Experience advancing modern AI-enabled design and product development approaches using tools such as Figma, Miro, Claude Design, Claude Code, Cursor, v0, and GitHub.
* Experience defining and scaling human-agent interaction patterns, AI experience standards, or related organizational capabilities, a plus.

WORKING MODEL
  
  
This role is based in GBS Warsaw and follows a hybrid working model, with a minimum expectation of two days per week in the office. Working model details will be confirmed as part of the recruiting process.

ABOUT TRUELOGIC

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.




OUR CLIENT

Our client is a membership-based community bringing together C-suite leaders, investors, and innovators who are focused on driving business transformation through meaningful discourse, collaboration, and the exchange of ideas. The organization is expanding its digital product capabilities to support more connected, intelligent, and high-value experiences for its members.



JOB SUMMARY

Our client is building a next-generation AI product centered on context-aware agent experiences. The platform brings together multi-channel conversations, persistent memory, user identity, action items, and long-running workflows to create intelligent experiences that can understand context and support users over time.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who combines strong product judgment, UX thinking, and technical fluency. This person will work at the intersection of product, design, and engineering, translating complex and ambiguous problems into clear product decisions and executable requirements.

The ideal candidate is comfortable discussing LLM behavior, state and data flows, permissions, failure modes, and edge cases with engineers, while also thinking deeply about usability, trust, and the overall user experience.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Shape the end-to-end product vision, strategy, and user experience for a conversational AI and agent-based product.

 - Lead product discovery, identify user needs, evaluate opportunities, and prioritize initiatives based on user and business impact.

 - Translate ambiguous problems and early-stage concepts into clear product requirements, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and actionable specifications.

 - Partner closely with engineering to reason through system architecture, LLM behavior, agent memory, identity models, state management, data flows, and technical constraints.

 - Work through complex edge cases, failure modes, error recovery, permissions, and user-control scenarios to ensure reliable product experiences.

 - Collaborate with design and engineering to move ideas from discovery through execution and launch.

 - Conduct and incorporate user research to validate assumptions and inform product decisions.

 - Write clear, concise product documentation and user-facing product copy when needed.

 - Make high-judgment tradeoffs between product velocity, usability, technical complexity, and system correctness.

 - Maintain a strong focus on user trust, privacy, continuity, and the quality of long-term interactions.




QUALIFICATIONS AND JOB REQUIREMENTS

 - Senior Product Management: Strong experience in product management, including product strategy, discovery, prioritization, and execution.

 - Product & UX Judgment: Strong understanding of UX and interaction design, with the ability to evaluate user journeys, flows, and product experiences at a high level.

product-manager._descripcion:
About Us:

Wrapbook is the AI platform for production finance. We’re building a system of action that puts finance teams in control of their whole production, from payroll, to spend, to accounting. 

Built for feature films, TV, and commercials, Wrapbook is trusted by teams at Netflix, Paramount, Anonymous Content, and more. With backing from Andreessen Horowitz, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Jeffrey Katzenberg's WndrCo, our team of 350+ is using AI to transform how finance teams work and empower them to do more with less.


Senior Product Manager II, Fraud & Identity (Remote – USA / CANADA)



Do you get energized by thinking like a bad actor so you can build the products that catch them? Is turning good analysis into a shipped, prioritized roadmap the thing you're proudest of, more than the analysis itself? Then this is the role for you.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager II to lead fraud and identity/authentication together at Wrapbook; two domains that lean on the same signals and the same underlying infrastructure, and work best under one owner. You'll define and drive the product strategy and roadmap for how we detect, prevent, and respond to fraud, and how we verify and protect identity, across the full customer lifecycle. This is a hands-on, build-with-engineers role, not a hand-it-off-and-wait one.

Fraud and identity also touch other teams' domains (company setup, worker onboarding, vendor payments, and more), so you'll work across those wherever it's relevant, bringing your Fraud expertise to influence and orchestrate a holistic, seamless fraud and identity customer experience. You'll also partner with the Legal & GRC team with your solutions as you own the tech that powers Wrapbook's KYC and AML compliance. You'll guide fraud operations (triage, investigation, case handling), enabling your partners in the Client Operations org. You own the product decisions: what gets detected, prevented, and surfaced to customers, and in what order. You'll report to the Senior Manager of Product Management, Onboarding & Lifecycle.



What you'll do:

 - Define and drive the product strategy and roadmap for fraud and identity/authentication across the customer lifecycle — from prevention to detection to response.

 - Prioritize and sequence the joint fraud + identity roadmap, weighing input across the teams whose backlogs it depends on.

 - Work directly with engineers on scoring logic and rules. Read a schema, reason about what a signal actually discriminates, and tell a good-sounding signal from a useful one.

 - Turn analysis into decisions that ship. Write decision docs that carry a clear recommendation and get acted on — not a comprehensive list of options with no ranking.

 - Act as incident commander for fraud incidents, coordinating engineering, Client Ops, GRC, Treasury, and Security, and evolve the playbooks so others can step in.

 - Define and instrument the fraud and identity health metrics that matter most — spanning detection accuracy, authentication coverage, and the customer friction it creates.

 - Say no upward, with evidence, when a new signal, a vendor, or a broad enforcement change would spend the friction budget without reducing real risk.

 - Partner with Legal/GRC on the compliance-adjacent surface your product touches (KYC/AML posture, audit walkthroughs) without taking on the compliance function itself.



What you'll have:

 - Owned a fraud, risk, or identity product surface at a payments, fintech, or marketplace company — not adjacent to it, owned it.

 - Real fluency in detection tradeoffs: precision vs. recall, the true cost of a false positive, and the idea of a finite friction budget.

 - Comfort working directly with engineers on scoring logic and schemas, not just briefing them and waiting.

 - Experience running or co-running incident response, with the instinct that the expensive part of fraud is the operational orchestration, not the detection build.

 - AI fluency/demonstrated experience working with/building with AI; using AI to increase the speed, accuracy, and automation throughout the fraud lifecycle.

 - A track record of decision docs that got decided and turned into shipped work, not just documented.

 - Experience in build/buy decisions around fraud platforms.

 - Comfortable pushing back on senior stakeholders with evidence, rather than deferring or complying by default.

 - Excellent written communication — Wrapbook is a document-forward, remote-first culture, and your writing is how people experience your thinking.



Extra Points If You Have:

 - You have any advanced financial industry certifications — CPA, CFA, CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner), etc.

 - You have payroll, payments, or other money-movement experience.

 - You have KYC/AML domain knowledge, or vendor/AP fraud experience.

 - You have hands-on experience with Auth0 or a comparable identity platform.

 - You have exposure to synthetic and AI-generated identity fraud patterns.

 - You love wearing a lot of hats and rolling up your sleeves to be hands-on with solving fraud problems.



This is a remote position open to candidates located in the United States or Canada. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas or work permits for this position. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country from which they will perform the work.


Why Join Us

At Wrapbook, creativity meets technology — and not just in the product.

In addition to a competitive salary and all the benefits you can expect from a fast-growing technology company, you’ll get access to a team of creative problem solvers and the chance to see your contributions make large impacts. Benefits include:

 - Unlimited Paid Time Off

 - Work from anywhere in Canada and USA

 - Health and Dental benefits

 - Up to $1,500 USD/ $2,025 CAD towards IT set up for your home

 - Up to 2% matching RRSP / 401K

 - Learning and Development opportunities

 - Up to $50 USD/ $67.50 CAD towards Internet/Cell phone service

Our Pledge to Fostering an Inclusive and Safe Workplace:

Wrapbook pledges to be a harassment- and discrimination-free space for everyone, regardless of age, disability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, nationality, neurotype, personal appearance, political affiliation, professional background, race, religion, or sexual identity or orientation.

Apply Now

Have we got your attention? Submit your application today and a member of our Talent team will be in touch with you shortly!

#LI-Remote

(3-4 años) Lanzamientos: Haber liderado el ciclo completo de al menos 3 lanzamientos de productos Herramientas Analíticas: Dominio avanzado de IQVIA y Close up para auditoría de ventas y recetas. Ofrecemos: Incorporación en multinacional farmacéutica de reconocido prestigio internacional Desarrollo personal y profesional Salario competitivo acorde al perfil del candidato/a Beneficios sociales: Comedor de empresa, seguros, flexibilidad horaria, teletrabajo. El talento no tiene etiquetas. Creemos firmemente que el talento no tiene género, edad, orientación sexual, origen, religión ni capacidades diferentes. Por ello, todos nuestros procesos de selección se basan en los principios de transparencia, objetividad e igualdad de oportunidades.

product-manager._descripcion:
We're on the hunt for an AI Product Manager to join our organization. This position is a great match for someone who flourishes where technology, business strategy, and go-to-market execution intersect. You'll operate across various functions, translating emerging AI capabilities into real-world solutions that create measurable impact for the business. If the idea of building tangible AI products while partnering with sales, marketing, and operations teams excites you, this role could be the right fit

**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with Worldwide Field Operations, encompassing Sales, Sales Architects and Engineers, Renewals, Channels, RevOps, Professional Services, and Customer Support, along with Marketing and Product teams, to surface AI opportunities and clarify the problem, intended users, and success criteria
* Chart go-to-market workflows from start to finish, covering lead-to-cash, renewals, partner deal registration, issue-to-resolution, and feedback-to-roadmap, with the goal of cutting out unnecessary steps and manual work
* Take ownership of the AI backlog tied to go-to-market efforts, ranking incoming requests according to business value, required effort, risk level, and strategic alignment
* Assess each incoming request to determine the best path forward, whether that's a custom-built AI agent, a low-code or no-code solution, AI functionality embedded in SaaS platforms like Salesforce, Gong, or Marketo, or broader workflow automation
* Develop solutions addressing account research, meeting preparation, pipeline forecasting, renewals, partner enablement, RFP responses, case triage, campaign and content operations, and product feedback workflows
* Independently construct and deploy AI agents, Claude Projects, and automated workflows, taking them all the way from early prototype to full production
* Draft well-defined requirements, then build out solutions with the help of AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, covering the necessary APIs and integrations
* Establish evaluation frameworks addressing accuracy, tone, customer impact, and human oversight, while upholding AI governance, security, and privacy standards alongside Security, Legal, and Enterprise Architecture teams
* Push adoption forward through training and enablement programs, while monitoring metrics like time saved for sellers, cycle time, case resolution speed, and pipeline quality

**Requirements**

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree, or comparable hands-on experience
* At least 8 years of relevant background in software development, product management, RevOps, Sales, Marketing, Support Ops, or business systems
* A minimum of 3 years spent in Senior, Lead, Manager, or Owner-level positions
* Demonstrated history overseeing engagements for teams of 20 or more full-time staff
* Direct experience building and launching AI agents and automation tools using platforms such as ChatGPT or Gemini
* Practical, hands-on development background with AI coding assistants like Claude Code, including experience with APIs, integrations, and enterprise-level data
* Solid familiarity with prompt engineering, RAG, tool use, and methods for evaluating AI performance
* Deep understanding of B2B sales, renewals, and channel ecosystems, plus insight into how deals flow through delivery, support, and renewal cycles
* Practical experience working with Salesforce and go-to-market platforms such as Gong, Clari, or PSA tools
* Capability to establish credibility with sellers, engineers, and go-to-market leadership, translating AI topics into straightforward business language
* Working familiarity with Salesforce Sales Cloud
* Fluent English communication skills at a B2 level or higher

**Nice to have**

* Background working with Conga CLM
* Knowledge of AI governance approaches, along with familiarity with AWS Bedrock and Adobe Marketo Engage
* Exposure to low-code agentic automation platforms and agentic workflow design
* Hands-on background with Anthropic Claude and business process analysis
* Understanding of context engineering, Glean, and Model Context Protocol
* Familiarity with Salesforce CPQ, Salesforce Service Cloud, Agentforce, and Salesforce Apex
* Holding relevant certifications, which would be seen as a valuable bonus

**We offer**

* International projects with top brands
* Work with global teams of highly skilled, diverse peers
* Healthcare benefits
* Employee financial programs
* Paid time off and sick leave
* Upskilling, reskilling and certification courses
* Unlimited access to the LinkedIn Learning library and 22,000+ courses
* Global career opportunities
* Volunteer and community involvement opportunities
* EPAM Employee Groups
* Award-winning culture recognized by Glassdoor, Newsweek and LinkedIn

*EPAM is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

Diseñar iniciativas de marketing y comunicación omnicanal, adaptando contenidos y canales a las necesidades de los distintos segmentos de profesionales de la salud. Desarrollar materiales promocionales y herramientas de apoyo comercial, coordinando su revisión y aprobación con las áreas correspondientes. Trabajar con el área Médica para asegurar la consistencia científica de los mensajes, respetando los ámbitos de responsabilidad de cada función. Coordinar con Acceso y el equipo Institucional las iniciativas que contribuyan al desarrollo del portafolio en cuentas públicas y privadas. Acompañar al equipo comercial en terreno, recogiendo información del mercado y fortaleciendo la implementación de las estrategias de marca. Participar en la capacitación del equipo comercial sobre posicionamiento, competencia y herramientas de promoción, en coordinación con el área Médica. Gestionar el presupuesto de marketing y evaluar la efectividad de las inversiones, proponiendo ajustes según resultados y prioridades. Elaborar proyecciones de demanda junto con Comercial y Supply Chain, considerando lanzamientos, evolución del mercado y oportunidades de acceso. Coordinar congresos, eventos e iniciativas promocionales con profesionales de la salud, conforme a las políticas corporativas y los procesos de aprobación. Asegurar que todas las acciones se ajusten a las indicaciones aprobadas, la normativa aplicable y los estándares de ética y compliance de la compañía. Requisitos del perfil Título profesional en Ingeniería Comercial, Química y Farmacia, carreras de la salud o afines. Al menos 5 años de experiencia en la industria farmacéutica, incluyendo un mínimo de 2 años en posiciones de Product Manager o gestión de marcas. Experiencia en Oncología, idealmente en compañías multinacionales. Se valorará trayectoria en terapias de especialidad o de alta complejidad. Experiencia en elaboración de planes de marketing, gestión de presupuestos y análisis de resultados comerciales. Deseable experiencia en lanzamientos de productos o nuevas indicaciones. Conocimiento del sistema de salud chileno y de las dinámicas de acceso y atención del paciente oncológico en los sectores público y privado. Capacidad para comprender evidencia clínica y traducirla en propuestas de posicionamiento y mensajes promocionales aprobados. Experiencia en estrategias omnicanal, segmentación y uso de herramientas de análisis de mercado. Inglés avanzado para interactuar con equipos regionales y globales, revisar documentación y presentar planes de negocio.

product-manager._descripcion:
### **Get to know us**

Ideals is a global B2B SaaS product company recognized as the most highly rated and customer-centric brand in the secure business collaboration market. Trusted by over 2,000,000 users from 300,000 companies globally, we help people run high-stakes processes and make important decisions with less stress, higher quality, and shorter hours.

Ideals Virtual Data Room (VDR): Secure document sharing and collaboration for due diligence, fundraising, corporate reporting, licensing, clinical trials, and other complex transactions.

Ideals Board: Board and leadership collaboration platform for faster, safer, and more compliant decision-making.

### **The role**

As a **Senior Product Manager** for our Virtual Data Room (VDR), you’ll be responsible for improving the experience of M&A advisors and investment bankers, a strategically important audience with a major impact on deal activity, platform adoption, and long-term business growth.

By deeply understanding M&A advisors’ needs, friction points, and growth opportunities, you will turn discovery insights into scalable new features or completely new products that increase engagement, strengthen loyalty, and drive repeatable business impact.

Working closely with engineering, design, data, marketing, and client-facing teams, you will help shape a product experience that delivers greater value for M&A advisors and supports the continued growth of this audience.

This role is open to candidates based in Ukraine, Portugal, Poland, the Czech Republic, Serbia or Spain.

### **What you will do**

* Define and execute the product strategy for M&A advisors inside the VDR and on adjacent areas, ensuring alignment with the overall product strategy and company vision
* Continuously identify, test, and scale high-impact opportunities that strengthen product-market fit and increase stickiness, loyalty, and repeat product usage among M&A advisors
* Proactively uncover new product opportunities through structured discovery, leveraging user interviews, surveys, behavioral analytics, support and feedback analysis, market and competitor research, data deep-dives, experimentation, and close collaboration with stakeholders
* Prioritize opportunities and solutions based on user reach, impact, ROI, technical feasibility, and business risk, while maintaining a balanced roadmap that spans innovation, optimization, technical excellence, and cross-functional initiatives
* Define and communicate product requirements through interactive prototypes, well-structured PRDs, and user stories with detailed acceptance criteria
* Collaborate with engineers, designers, UX writers, and data analysts within cross-functional product teams to co-create and deliver scalable, high-quality solutions
* Contribute to GTM strategy and work with the marketing team to develop launch plans, positioning, and messaging that drive product adoption and market success
* Measure success post-launch and iterate based on data and feedback

### **What you bring**

* 3+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS or enterprise environments
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to work independently and drive outcomes
* Proven experience across the full product lifecycle – from discovery to go-to-market and post-release activities
* Skilled in using both customer insights and data to inform product decisions
* Ability to turn industry and market trends into clear product strategies
* Passion for delivering intuitive, user-friendly, and impactful experiences
* Hands-on use of AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT or similar) in daily product work to multiply output and reduce time spent on research, documentation, data analysis, and routine tasks
* Experience working on technically complex features or workflows and collaborating closely with engineering teams
* Excellent collaboration, communication, and English proficiency (C1 level)

### **Nice to have**

* Experience building or owning AI-powered features (e.g., LLM integrations, AI-assisted insights generation, chat with data, etc.)
* Understanding of M&A, fundraising, and other financial operations

### **Our assessment process**

* Screening call with the Talent Acquisition Specialist (~55 mins)
* Product management expertise and problem discovery interview with the Group Product Manager (90-120 min)
* Home task: hypotheses preparation (2–4 hours effort, 1–2 days turnaround)
* Product strategy interview with the Director of Engineering and VP of Product Management (60 min)
* Competency-based interview with the Talent Acquisition Specialist (90 mins)

### **What we offer**

We highly value our people, so we will empower you with all the resources and support to help you reach your full potential.

### **For your best work**

* Remote-first flexibility to shape your ideal workday
* Home workplace budget
* Resilient home budget for Ukraine-based teammates
* Resilient office in Kyiv & co-working expense coverage
* Individual IT budget for extra equipment
* Top-tier tech and AI-powered tools

### **For your growth**

* Access to Ideals Academy with numerous courses
* Investment in external learning and development activities
* Guidance in Personal Development Plan creation
* Professional literature and subscriptions coverage
* Support of your passion as a speaker or writer
* Internal talent mobility opportunities

### **For your well-being**

* Medical insurance and Wellness Package for sport-related activities
* Full coverage of mental health sessions for Ukrainian teammates
* Funding for sports competitions
* 20 business days of paid time off per year
* Unlimited health-related time-off

### **Extra perks**

* Budget for meetups with your local team
* Generous internal referral program

### **Our culture**

Commitment, Excellence, Collaboration, Trust and Care are core values to the Ideals team. For us, these are the principles that every Idealer lives and breathes. We are on the lookout for like-minded individuals who share our values. By doing so, we create a team where talents feel at ease and work to the best of their abilities.

Discover more.

**Ideals is an equal opportunity employer**

Ideals is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people from all walks of life. We don’t discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, or citizenship.

product-manager._descripcion:
We are looking for an AI Product Manager to join our team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of technology, business strategy, and go-to-market operations. You'll work across multiple functions to turn emerging AI capabilities into practical solutions that drive measurable business value. If you're excited about building hands-on AI products while collaborating with sales, marketing, and operations teams, this opportunity is a great match

**Responsibilities**

* Partner with Worldwide Field Operations, including Sales, Sales Architects and Engineers, Renewals, Channels, RevOps, Professional Services, and Customer Support, as well as Marketing and Product, to identify AI opportunities and define the problem, target users, and success measures
* Map go-to-market processes end to end, including lead-to-cash, renewals, partner deal registration, issue-to-resolution, and feedback-to-roadmap, to eliminate unnecessary steps and reduce manual effort
* Own the AI backlog for go-to-market initiatives, prioritizing requests based on business value, effort, risk, and strategic fit
* Triage incoming requests to determine the right approach, whether a custom AI agent, low-code or no-code build, AI embedded within SaaS tools such as Salesforce, Gong, or Marketo, or workflow automation
* Build solutions supporting account research, meeting preparation, pipeline and forecasting, renewals, partner enablement, RFP response, case triage, and campaign and content operations, as well as product feedback processes
* Build and ship AI agents, Claude Projects, and automated workflows independently, carrying work from prototype through to production
* Write clear requirements, then develop solutions using AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, including related APIs and integrations
* Set up evaluation processes covering accuracy, tone, customer impact, and human review, while applying AI governance, security, and privacy standards in partnership with Security, Legal, and Enterprise Architecture teams
* Drive adoption through training and enablement efforts, while tracking metrics such as seller time saved, cycle time, case resolution time, and pipeline quality

**Requirements**

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree, or equivalent practical experience
* A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in software development, product management, RevOps, Sales, Marketing, Support Ops, or business systems
* At least 2 years in Senior, Lead, Manager, or Owner-level roles
* A proven track record managing engagements for teams of 5 or more full-time employees
* Hands-on experience building and shipping AI agents and automations using tools such as ChatGPT or Gemini
* Practical development experience using AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, including working with APIs, integrations, and enterprise data
* Working knowledge of prompt engineering, RAG, tool use, and AI evaluation methods
* Strong understanding of B2B sales, renewals, and channel dynamics, along with how deals progress through delivery, support, and renewal stages
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce and go-to-market tools such as Gong, Clari, or PSA platforms
* Ability to build trust with sellers, engineers, and go-to-market leaders, and to communicate AI concepts in clear business terms
* Working knowledge of Salesforce Sales Cloud
* Fluent English communication skills at a B2 level or higher

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Conga CLM
* Familiarity with AI governance practices, AWS Bedrock, and Adobe Marketo Engage
* Exposure to agentic automation low-code platforms and agentic workflows
* Experience with Anthropic Claude and business process analysis
* Knowledge of context engineering, Glean, and Model Context Protocol
* Familiarity with Salesforce CPQ, Salesforce Service Cloud, Agentforce, and Salesforce Apex
* Relevant certifications, which would be considered a valuable addition to your qualifications

**We offer**

* International projects with top brands
* Work with global teams of highly skilled, diverse peers
* Healthcare benefits
* Employee financial programs
* Paid time off and sick leave
* Upskilling, reskilling and certification courses
* Unlimited access to the LinkedIn Learning library and 22,000+ courses
* Global career opportunities
* Volunteer and community involvement opportunities
* EPAM Employee Groups
* Award-winning culture recognized by Glassdoor, Newsweek and LinkedIn

product-manager._descripcion: Building the Future of Open Finance Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. The team Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Consumer Trading is a full-stack team behind the Consumer experience in Kraken mobile and web applications. Our flagship product allows our clients to instantly buy, sell, convert any combination of stocks, cryptocurrencies and cash. We are constantly working on extending the product suite with new features and improvements. The opportunity Own the connective tissue between marketing and product at Kraken Consumer — a remit with real scope to shape how millions of people discover and return to our products. Build something from the ground up: the roadmap, the intake model and the standards for how marketing and product work together are all yours to define. Sit at the centre of the acquisition funnel, where small improvements in conversion compound into meaningful growth. Unlock new acquisition channels by building the product surfaces they depend on — paid social, search, affiliates and offline campaigns. Shape a fast-growing mobile acquisition motion, including in-product social, creator partnerships, community and friend-referral mechanics. Own both halves of the lifecycle: bringing new users in, and giving existing users compelling reasons to come back. Work in one of the most competitive corners of consumer fintech, where conversion craft and product quality genuinely decide who wins. What You Bring Own the marketing product roadmap end to end, and build the process that turns campaign ideas into shipped product work. Design and launch tailored campaign experiences — the in-app and web journeys users land in from push, email, social and paid. Raise the bar on lifecycle messaging so push and email feel useful rather than noisy, and convert accordingly. Own the incentives layer for new and returning users: offers, referral mechanics, recurring deposits and earn-led campaigns. Apply user psychology and sharp UX thinking to find where the funnel leaks, then run the experiments that close the gaps. Improve landing page and search performance, and build the product foundations that make paid and offline channels measurable and worth the spend. Partner with marketing, design, engineering and data as the single point of ownership for growth enablement. Define the acquisition and reactivation metrics that matter, and report on them honestly — including when an experiment doesn't land. Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. Our commitment Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. product-manager._descripcion:
Veeva is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences through software, data, AI, and business consulting working together. Learn more about our products, vision, values, and status as a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) on our website.

Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Launched in 2019, Veeva Business Consulting has grown quickly and organically to over 500 global experts who combine deep domain knowledge with innovative technology to help Life Sciences companies work in a more efficient and connected way.

We are growing aggressively as we look towards 2030. We are seeking great people to help shape the future of the industry with the world’s leading software, data, AI, and expertise at their back.

The Role

As Senior Director, Product Management for EU, you will be Veeva Nitro's senior product presence in Europe. Nitro is our AI-native data platform that democratizes life sciences data for non-technical commercial teams, turning fragmented HCP/HCO, prescription, and industry data into decisions the field can act on.

Europe is a critical and complex market for Nitro, with multi-country field operations, strict data privacy requirements, and sophisticated customers who expect a platform that understands their world. You will deeply understand EU customers, advocate for their needs in the global product roadmap, and partner with engineering to deliver on those needs. You'll work across product, engineering, sales, services, legal, and compliance to ensure Nitro is built for Europe and wins in Europe.

You are an AI-native product leader who thinks about what the platform should decide and recommend, not just what it should store or display. You measure success with outcomes — product adoption, customer satisfaction, deal velocity, renewals, expansions. You are equally credible in a customer boardroom in Paris and in a roadmap review with engineering. You are energized by working at startup speed inside a global enterprise.

What You'll Do



- EU Customer Discovery & Advocacy: Own the EU customer relationship pipeline, from discovery interviews to exec briefings to conference presence. You are the primary feedback loop between European pharma and the global roadmap
- EU Product Delivery: Set priorities for the dedicated EU engineering workstream and own the outcomes of those features
- Regulatory & Data Compliance: Own the product's compliance posture in Europe. Partner with legal and security to ensure Nitro meets GDPR, data residency, and EMA requirements, and turn compliance into a competitive strength
- Go-to-Market Partnership: Get in the room early on EU deals. Partner with sales and services to position Nitro, handle product objections, and accelerate time-to-value for new customers
- Market Intelligence: Know the EU competitive landscape, regulatory pipeline, and local data ecosystem, and use it to influence product strategy
- AI-Native Product Leadership: Push the product toward innovative capabilities and ways of working, rather than automating existing processes. Be the voice in EU customer rooms that articulates what AI-native analytics actually means for commercial teams
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Connect the dots across engineering, legal, security, compliance, services, and consulting so EU commitments land
- Executive Alignment: Represent the EU market and customer perspective to Veeva and Nitro leadership. Bring a clear point of view on where to invest, what's working, and what needs to change

Requirements



- Leadership: 8+ years in product management with demonstrated success on enterprise SaaS or data platforms
- Domain Expertise: Deep life sciences commercial, medical, and regulatory expertise including HCP/HCO data, Rx/prescription data, claims, and field force operations, ideally across multiple EU markets
- EU Market Expertise: Strong understanding of the European life sciences market, multi-country dynamics, and EU regulatory and data-privacy requirements including GDPR, data residency, and EMA
- AI/Data Fluency: Hands-on product experience with AI/ML, analytics, or data platforms with the ability to shape and advocate for AI-driven capabilities and hold a credible product conversation with customers and engineering alike
- Customer Obsession: Builds relationships that go beyond the sale, with deep knowledge of customer workflows, frustrations, and definitions of success
- Data-Driven: Sets clear success metrics and uses data to prioritize, advocate, and report on outcomes
- Customer-Facing Credibility: Proven ability to lead executive customer conversations and translate them into product direction
- Execution: Comfortable influencing across teams in a globally distributed, remote-first environment
- Education: Bachelor's degree or higher; equivalent experience considered

Nice to Have



- Experience with Veeva Vault, Veeva CRM, or the broader life sciences technology ecosystem
- Experience building or scaling an AI-native product from an early stage
- Working proficiency in one or more European languages beyond English

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect. 



- Follow the application process and submit your resume.
- Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party, unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously.
- Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
- If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:

- A conversation with the hiring manager
- A practical case exercise
- A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
- Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision. Perks & Benefits



- Compensation: Highly competitive salary and equity in Veeva
- Growth: Unrivalled career progression in a fast-growing, global team
- Flexibility: Veeva is a Work Anywhere company. You can work from home or the office on any given day

Compensation



- Total compensation: 75,000 - 220,000 EUR
- The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Gender, race, ethnicity, religion, politics, sexual orientation, age, disability and life experience shape us all into unique individuals. We value people for the individuals they are and the contributions they can bring to our teams.

CALIDAD PASCUAL, S.A.U. tratará los datos que facilites como responsable del tratamiento con la finalidad de gestionar tu candidatura. Durante el proceso, podrán utilizarse herramientas basadas en inteligencia artificial como apoyo, siempre bajo supervisión humana. product-manager._descripcion: At ASAPP, our mission is simple: deliver the best AI-powered customer experience—faster than anyone else. To achieve that, we’re guided by principles that shape how we think, build, and execute. We value customer obsession, purposeful speed, ownership, and a relentless focus on outcomes. We work in tight, skilled teams, prioritize clarity over complexity, and continuously evolve through curiosity, data, and craftsmanship. We’re seeking technologists and problem solvers who thrive in fast-paced environments, love collaborating with great talent, and approach every day like it’s Day 1. We're a globally diverse team with hubs in New York City, Mountain View, Latin America, and India. If you're driven by continuous learning, rapid pivots, and the challenges of building in a high-growth startup, we’d love to talk. This is more than a job—it’s a journey. This is not a reporting role. You will own the data layer that makes ASAPP's platform trustworthy and actionable — the models, dashboards, feeds, and APIs that let builders, supervisors, analysts, and executives at our customers see exactly what GenerativeAgent (GA) is doing, how well it's doing it, and its value. If customers can't see the value we create, they can't renew, expand, or defend the investment internally. That visibility is your product. We’re looking for candidates based in the Buenos Aires Metropolitan Area, Argentina. What You Will Do Drive the roadmap for customer-facing dashboards and analytics. Lead product for surfaces like the Supervisor homepage and dashboards, that let supervisors break down GA performance by custom questions, quality signals, containment, escalation, and resolution metrics. Balance depth for power users with clarity for first-time users. Build the value realization story. Translate raw platform data into the metrics that prove ROI — containment, escalation rate, verified resolution rate, ASAPP Score, CSAT — and partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Analytics to package these into narratives customers can bring to their own leadership. Own exportable data feeds and real-time data APIs. Design and manage the feeds and APIs that let customers pull ASAPP data into their own BI stacks and data warehouses. Treat schema changes, naming, and versioning as customer commitments, not implementation details. Own the data strategy layer. Define how events and metrics are structured and named across the platform, so that data is consistent, well-governed, and built to scale as new use cases (voice, new verticals, new GA capabilities) come online. Lead data discovery for strategic customer launches. Work directly with enterprise customers to identify the KPIs that matter to their business — payment integrity, retention, voice quality, and domain-specific signals — and turn them into structured data questions, evals, and dashboard views. Partner deeply with Engineering and Data Science on the underlying event and schema architecture (chat/voice event protocols, PII handling, real-time vs. batch tradeoffs) to make sure product decisions are grounded in what's technically sound and scalable. Manage the trust layer of the data experience. Proactively identify and resolve issues that erode confidence in dashboards and feeds — data availability gaps, date-range mismatches, truncation, latency — and design the UX and guardrails that keep customers confident in the numbers. Who You Are We evaluate candidates against a set of principles. These are not interview talking points — they describe how PMs are expected to operate here every day. Growth & Abundance Mindset: You approach new domains with curiosity and learn fast. You see collaboration as additive, not competitive. When a bet doesn't work, you extract the signal and move on. Extreme Ownership: You take responsibility to deliver. You don't wait to be asked — you identify the gap and close it. You are the PM; the outcome is yours. High-Velocity Outcomes: You measure yourself by outcomes, not output. You distinguish between shipping a feature and moving a metric. You can answer "what changed for the customer?" for everything on your roadmap. Effective Communication, Collaboration, and Trust: You influence without authority across engineering, data science, design, sales, and customer success. You overcommunicate to keep stakeholders aligned. Real-Time Feedback: You give and receive feedback continuously rather than saving it for quarterly reviews. When something is wrong, you say so directly and constructively. What You Will Need 5+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time spent on data, analytics, or reporting products in enterprise B2B SaaS. Working fluency in data modeling and schema design — you can have a real conversation with engineers about event taxonomies, table structures, and naming conventions, and you know why consistency compounds. Experience shipping customer-facing dashboards or reporting tools, including the UX judgment to know when a metric needs more explanation, a warning state, or a different visualization. Experience defining or managing data feeds, exports, or APIs built for external customer consumption — you understand feeds are a contract, not a one-time delivery. Comfort turning ambiguous or noisy data into a clear, defensible story about value or ROI for a non-technical, often executive, audience. Track record of running customer discovery and translating it into structured requirements — KPIs, metrics definitions, or evaluation criteria. Excellent written communication — you can write a clear PRD, a release announcement, and a customer-facing value narrative without three rounds of rewrites. What We Would Like To See Prior experience in a startup or fast-scaling environment where the role's scope evolved as the company did. Experience building "value realization" or ROI content used in customer business reviews (QBRs) or renewal conversations. Benefits Competitive compensation Stock options Healthcare for the family group Mac equipment USD 150 per month in flexible benefits 3 weeks of vacation English lessons ASAPP is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or veteran status. If you have a disability and need assistance with our employment application process, please email us at [email protected] to obtain assistance. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
