ux-ui-designer._descripcion:
We Are Waiting for You

Hi there!

I am Álvaro Gallego, the recruiter for this position. Nice to meet you!

First, a little bit about what I like the most about working at Zurich Technology Delivery Center: The environment here is incredibly collaborative and innovative. Our tech-driven mindset fosters continuous learning and growth, creating an atmosphere where everyone can thrive. Now, I can't wait to share this exciting journey with you at Zurich!

First of all, THANK YOU for considering our company. We understand that finding the right opportunity can be tough, but I’ll try to make it easier.

Who Are We?

Let me introduce us. You’re reading about Zurich Insurance Group, a global leader in insurance, but this role specifically pertains to our Technology Delivery Center (TDC). Established in Barcelona in 2006, the TDC operates as an integral part of Zurich Insurance Group, providing cutting-edge technological solutions and support to Zurich's local and global business units.

In essence, Zurich TDC is where technology meets the vast reach of a multinational company. We specialize in areas such as software development, data analytics, cybersecurity, and IT infrastructure. Our primary mission is to support Zurich's strategic goals and enhance operational efficiency through innovative technology solutions.

If you're considering a role with us, know that you'll be joining a hub of technological excellence dedicated to driving Zurich's success on a global scale.

What Can You Expect?

And you might be thinking: This is great, what will my day-to-day be like, at TDC? I’m glad you asked.

As a UX Researcher Senior you will have the opportunity to:



- Collaborate on strategic and innovative initiatives that improve the experience of internal users, such as underwriters, claims handlers, and other business teams across Zurich. 
- Lead end-to-end research activities across multiple projects, from discovery and user interviews to usability testing, insights synthesis, and recommendations. 
- Support product and business teams in understanding user needs, behaviours, pain points, and opportunities, helping shape more user-centred solutions. 
- Contribute to the design and validation of innovative experiences, including conversational AI, intelligent workflows, and emerging digital solutions. 
- Partner with UX/UI designers, product owners, engineers, architects, and business stakeholders to ensure user insights are considered throughout the product lifecycle. 
- Drive evidence-based decision making through a combination of user research, business understanding, market trends, and qualitative and quantitative insights. 
- Explore new research approaches, tools, and technologies that help the team continuously improve the way we understand and support our users. 
- Work across multiple initiatives simultaneously, balancing priorities while maintaining a high standard of research quality and impact. 
- Enhance your skills through exposure to complex enterprise products, AI-enabled experiences, and cross-functional collaboration. 
- Contribute to a team that values curiosity, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.

What Makes You a great Fit?

While we’re not seeking perfection or expecting you to save the world, we believe that if you meet some of these requirements, you’ll be a fantastic fit for our team.

We are particularly interested in someone who sees research not only as a validation activity, but as a way to uncover opportunities, challenge assumptions, and help teams make better-informed decisions.



- Individual Contribution and Technical Requirements
- You have significant experience as a UX Researcher working on digital products, enterprise platforms, or complex user journeys.
- You are skilled in a wide range of research methodologies, including user interviews, usability testing, discovery research, surveys, workshops, and concept validation.
- You can translate research findings into clear, actionable insights into clear recommendations that support product, business, and design decisions.
- You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and identifying the right questions before jumping to solutions.
- You have experience working with complex stakeholder environments where business objectives, user needs, operational realities, and technical constraints must be balanced.
- You bring a strategic mindset and are able to connect user insights with broader business goals and opportunities.
- You are proactive, curious, and continuously look for opportunities to improve products, services, and ways of working.
- You have strong storytelling and communication skills, allowing you to influence decisions through evidence, insights, and actionable recommendations
- You are comfortable working on multiple initiatives simultaneously and adapting to changing priorities.
- Experience with AI-enabled experiences, conversational interfaces, intelligent assistants, automation, or emerging technologies is highly desirable.
- Experience with UX/UI design, prototyping, Figma, service design, or front-end technologies would be considered a strong advantage.
- Project Management Skills
- You are able to manage and prioritize research activities across multiple projects simultaneously.
- You can independently plan research initiatives, define objectives, manage timelines, and deliver meaningful outcomes.
- You are organised, adaptable, and comfortable operating in dynamic environments with evolving priorities.
- You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- You can facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, and alignment activities that help teams move forward with confidence.
- You are able to identify risks, dependencies, and opportunities throughout the research lifecycle.
- You understand how to influence decisions through evidence, collaboration, and stakeholder engagement.
- You can build alignment among diverse stakeholders while maintaining a strong focus on user needs and business value.

And… What Makes Us Special?

As well as a competitive salary and a yearly bonus, we offer:



- To support your work-life balance, we have adopted a flexible working model.
- Option to work abroad up to 25 days yearly. 
- Over 300 euros to set up your home office and additional monthly home office allowance. 
- Wide range of internal and external trainings, including English, German and Spanish classes depending on the needs.
- Ticket restaurant and Health Insurance with the flexibility to exchange it for other benefits. 
- Life and accident insurance. 
- Collective Life retirement Plan
- 2000 referral bonus if you bring other talented people like you to the company. 
- Special banking and insurance conditions plus Exclusive Employees discounts 
- Functional diversity benefits 
- Stock options and mortgage benefits.

Where Are We Located?

Barcelona, Poblenou.

We Are Waiting for You.

Can you see yourself in this role? Don’t wait any longer! Apply by sending your CV in English.

If not, no worries! We’ll meet again in the future. Feel free to share my contact details with anyone you think would be a great fit.

At Zurich, we are an equal opportunity employer. We attract and retain the best-qualified individuals available, regardless of race/ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability.

Zurich Technology Delivery Center – Your Talent, Our Strength

You are the heart & soul of Zurich! 

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We highly value the experience and know-how of our employees and offer a wide range of opportunities across business areas to encourage you to apply for new opportunities within Zurich when you are ready for your next career step.

Let’s continue to grow together!



- Location(s): ES - Barcelona 
- Schedule: Full Time
- Recruiter name: Alvaro Gallego Zazo

You'll help contributors develop the confidence, skills, and knowledge
ux-ui-designer._descripcion: The Wikimedia Foundation is seeking a Lead Learning Experience Designer to create innovative, engaging, and accessible learning experiences that strengthen the capacity of volunteers and communities across the Wikimedia movement. You'll help contributors develop the confidence, skills, and knowledge they need to participate effectively, navigate Wikimedia’s communities and practices, and grow as contributors. In this role, you'll partner with Foundation teams, affiliates, researchers, subject matter experts, and volunteers to understand learner needs, identify barriers to participation, and develop learning experiences that support contributors at different stages of their journey. This role goes beyond traditional instructional design. You’ll think like a learning product designer, finding the right approach for each challenge, whether that means creating an online course on Wikimedia’s learning management system (LMS), WikiLearn, producing multimedia content, experimenting with emerging technologies, or embedding learning into existing experiences and workflows. You will do all this while ensuring the experiences you create are culturally responsive, accessible, and relevant to a global audience. This role is intended for an experienced individual who is comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy and making decisions in complex, evolving environments. Success in this role means being a curious, resourceful problem solver who understands how people learn, grow, and participate. You can think big about how learning can strengthen the Wikimedia movement, while also rolling up your sleeves to build, experiment, and iterate on solutions that make a meaningful difference. Responsibilities Design and develop innovative digital learning experiences, capacity-strengthening resources, and performance support solutions for contributors across the Wikimedia movement. Partner with product teams, community groups, researchers, and subject matter experts to identify learning needs, contributor challenges, and opportunities to strengthen participation. Determine the right learning approach for each opportunity, whether that be a self-paced course, video, interactive experience, AI-enabled support, workshop, or embedded guidance. Develop learning experiences that support contributors in understanding new tools, workflows, policies, governance processes, and community practices across Wikimedia projects. Rapidly prototype, test and iterate on learning experiences, using modern authoring tools, multimedia, and AI tools. Apply learning science, user-centered design, and learning experience design methodologies to create engaging, effective, and inclusive solutions. Evaluate learning effectiveness using learner feedback, participation data, and other qualitative and quantitative insights, continuously improving content based on evidence and community feedback. Contribute to the ongoing evolution of the Foundation's learning strategy by staying current with learning technology, online learning, AI, and digital engagement, identifying opportunities to expand and strengthen learning offerings across the movement. Ensure learning resources reflect Wikimedia's values of openness, collaboration, equity, and knowledge sharing. Qualifications Required Experience designing and developing digital learning experiences for diverse, global audiences. Demonstrated experience creating engaging e-learning, instructor-led, virtual, or blended learning solutions. Experience using a learning management system (LMS) to develop, organize, and publish learning content. Demonstrated ability to diagnose capability gaps, identify the right interventions, and rapidly design, build and improve learning experiences. Excellent written communication and content development skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for diverse audiences. Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders and subject matter experts. Commitment to accessibility, inclusive design, and culturally responsive learning practices. Preferred Experience working with volunteer communities, open knowledge initiatives, nonprofits, or international organizations. Experience designing learning for multilingual audiences and collaborating across cultures and time zones. ### **Sobre a Mirante Tecnologia**

Há mais de 28 anos, a Mirante apoia grandes empresas em sua transformação digital por meio da modernização de sistemas, desenvolvimento de soluções sob medida e inovação tecnológica.

Com quase mil especialistas em todo o Brasil, combinamos excelência técnica e visão de negócio para entregar soluções que geram impacto real em organizações dos setores financeiro, energia, indústria, serviços e governo.

* PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:
* Planejar, conduzir e documentar pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas com usuários. Gerar insights acionáveis para apoiar decisões de produto e design.

Acreditamos que tecnologia só gera valor quando resolve problemas reais. Por isso, atuamos lado a lado com nossos clientes para transformar desafios complexos em soluções digitais que impulsionam negócios.

Aqui você encontrará espaço para aprender, propor ideias, evoluir tecnicamente e participar de projetos que impactam milhares de pessoas todos os dias.

ux-ui-designer._descripcion: Hey there! We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment. Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment. Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences. Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right? To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment! Ready to be part of the experience? Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission. About The Role We’re looking for a passionate Senior User Researcher to join our growing team and lead B2C and B2B research for Fever Sports . From conversion funnels on our consumer-facing pages to inventory management on the event configuration platform our partners use, you’ll work with world-famous sports competitions and organizations. This role is perfect for someone with an analytical mindset, an eye for product design opportunities and a drive for excellence in everything they do. Once you’ve completed onboarding, you’ll have substantial autonomy and full ownership of the research outcomes for a company-sized vertical within Fever. You won’t wait for briefs: you’ll find the questions worth answering and bring them to the table. What you'll do Define and deliver the research roadmap for Fever Sports across B2C and B2B, together with Product Design and Product Management. Engage with senior stakeholders to source the business questions that matter, and prioritise between competing requests. Plan and run research studies with the right mix of qualitative and quantitative methods (e.g., usability testing, interviews, surveys, analysis of behavioural data, benchmarking). Build and test prototypes, and work with designers, PMs, Tech Leads and Engineers on UX decisions while keeping feasibility in mind. Turn findings into clear, actionable insights that drive real product and business decisions. Share your work with the wider organisation in an engaging way, and advocate for the User Research team and its work. Mentor less experienced researchers and guide the work of a more junior colleague. Improve our research processes and research ops using what you’ve learned in previous roles. About You Must have skills: Around 10 years of professional experience, with proven experience in User Research or a closely related field, and a track record of creating value. We’ll also consider candidates with 5+ years. Strong command of qualitative and quantitative methods, with particular depth in usability testing. The ability to understand the context behind a business question and design the right method to answer it. Solid hands-on data analysis skills with at least one analytical tool (e.g., Excel, SQL, SPSS). You use AI tools where they help, and you own the accuracy of every output. Experience running several complex projects in parallel, delivering high-quality work under time pressure to a wide range of stakeholders. Your findings stand up to close scrutiny. Comfort with ambiguity: you help ideas take shape with PMs and Product Designers and find ways forward when things are unclear. Strong prototype testing and prototype building skills. Professional proficiency in English or Spanish. It would be nice if you: Are a confident Figma user. Know platforms such as Hotjar, UserTesting, Maze or Mixpanel. Have a background in startup, scale-up or hypergrowth environments. Speak both English and Spanish, and other languages too. Are into sports such as football, racing, sailing, golf or tennis. Your growth trajectory In your first 3 months you’ll get to know Fever Sports inside out: its business model, its B2C and B2B products, our partners and the stakeholders you’ll work with. You’ll review the knowledge we already have, deliver your first studies alongside the team, and start spotting the biggest gaps in what we know. By month 6 you’ll fully own the research roadmap for Fever Sports, sourcing and prioritising the questions worth answering with senior stakeholders. Your output will shape important decisions and you’ll be helping shape how the research team works through processes and research ops. Benefits & Perks Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance. Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences Home office friendly Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with! Health insurance and other benefits such as Flexible remuneration with a 100% tax exemption through Cobee. English Lessons Gympass Membership Possibility to receive in advance part of your salary by Payflow. Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you! If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply! If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey. If you want to know more about how Fever processes your personal data, click here Fever - Candidate Privacy Notice

ux-ui-designer._descripcion:
**At Vueling, we connect people, places and opportunities** ️

As part of the IAG Group, we are one of Europe’s leading airlines, serving around 250 routes across 30 countries and welcoming millions of customers every year. With more than 5,000 employees, Vueling is the only European airline recognized as a Top Employer for three consecutive years. Driven by innovation, collaboration, and a commitment to sustainability, we are shaping the future of aviation while creating an environment where our people can grow, contribute, and make an impact.

**Mission**

Define, lead and oversee the end-to-end UI/UX research-and-design strategy and operating model for Vueling’s website and wider digital channels within E-commerce & Ancillaries, in accordance with user-centred design principles, the product development lifecycle (from prototyping to iterative improvement), cross-stakeholder requirements and the constraints of the low-cost model, in order to embed the voice of the user into product and interface decisions, maintain digital consistency, improve measurable experience health (e.g., customer satisfaction survey KPI) and ultimately drive revenue through better-performing digital experiences for Guests.

**Tasks & responsibilities**

* Define and implement UI/UX research strategies and methodologies appropriate to each phase of product development, from early prototyping through to research collaboration that supports A/B optimization testing.
* Lead and oversee user research activities such as usability testing, interviews, surveys, field research and task-based user validation exercises.
* Oversee the iterative working model between UI product designers and UX researchers so that designs are tested with users and refined based on research findings.
* Analyse and synthesise research data in order to translate findings into actionable insights, recommendations and design suggestions for stakeholders at all levels.
* Make the Design and Research teams AI-driven by embedding AI tools

  and practices into day-to-day workflows and identifying opportunities to redesign ways of working.
* Stay up to date with UX research and design trends, tools and methodologies relevant to digital experience improvement.
* Define and develop the overall strategy for the UI/UX Research and Design team as an integrated capability spanning UI product design and UX research.

**Academic background**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Design, or related field.

**Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in design strategy or UX research fields.
* Demonstrated experience defining and implementing a research strategy for product development, from prototyping through to supporting optimisation work.
* Proven experience working end-to-end with UI designers and UX researchers to iterate designs based on research recommendations.
* Experience operating with a collaborator-heavy team model, coordinating specialised contributors even where direct line management is limited.

**Skills**

* Strong knowledge of user-centred design thinking and how to champion it across an organisation.
* Full professional proficiency C1 in Spanish and English

**Vueling Values**  
Our values are what we believe in, what we stand for and how we behave.

* Make it happen
* Make it better
* Make it safe
* Make it cost-focused
* Make it customer-oriented
* Win together

*Vueling is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other status.*

ux-ui-designer._descripcion: As a Senior Digital-First Designer working hybrid in Bogotá, Colombia, you’ll be a part of the marketing department of TTEC. Our purpose, team, and company culture are amazing and our Great Place to Work® certification in Colombia says it all! #experienceTTEC. As a Digital-First Senior Designer on the Marketing team, you will play a key role in two areas: translating business information into compelling visual products that support our go-to-market, executive communications, and brand initiatives, and leading the creation and evolution of web assets and experiences across TTEC’s ecosystem of brands (Percepta, TTEC & TTEC Digital). This hybrid role sits between UX/UI, visual creativity, and brand design, with a strong focus on delivering high-performing, visually compelling, and user-centered web experiences. You will drive innovation across TTEC and Percepta's websites, exploring and applying new approaches in interactivity, multimedia, design systems, and AI-enabled experiences that elevate campaign effectiveness and web engagement. You will act as the primary design leader on the PERCEPTA brand department, crafting its communications and digital presence, while serving as the UX/UI leader across the TTEC web ecosystem. You will also contribute to the development of presentations, business communications, and information-rich marketing assets for PERCEPTA, applying strong storytelling, information design, and visual communication principles to simplify complex concepts and improve audience understanding. Strong understanding of modern web design principles, information architecture, responsive design, HTML fundamentals, and real-time prototyping tools such as Figma and Webflow is essential. A significant part of the role involves partnering closely with content, marketing, and implementation teams to continuously improve the user experience, visual quality, and performance of our web channels. This includes designing and refining site architecture, wireframes and templates, navigation systems, landing pages, user journeys, campaign experiences, and digital assets that keep our brands modern, cohesive, and effective. You will be expected to think beyond aesthetics, helping teams shape narratives, simplify complexity, and transform business challenges into effective communication and digital experience elements. What You Will Do Digital ideation: Bring fresh ideas for worldwide leader brands in the customer experience market, creating exciting opportunities for new thinking, research & interaction in the digital field. Seek to implement the most innovative tools on TTEC's web channels in terms of user experience, animation components, and graphic resources that capture the audience's attention and transform it into conversion and outcomes. Develop engaging UI and interaction designs, incorporating thoughtful data visualization and visual elements that improve comprehension and drive user engagement. Test, measure, and refine digital assets, web experiences, and visual solutions to optimize performance and effectiveness. Create low- and high-fidelity wireframes, prototypes, and experience concepts that support decision-making and accelerate implementation. Creative execution: Lead the development of design elements, presentations, sales materials, and other high-visibility corporate and marketing documents. Facilitate stakeholder discussions to define requirements, challenge assumptions, and align creative solutions with business objectives. Present design rationales and creative recommendations to stakeholders, to produce effective visual communications. Project management: Independently manage medium- to large-scale design initiatives from concept through final delivery. Provide strategic recommendations on content structure, storytelling approaches, and visual frameworks that improve communication effectiveness in our web channels and communications. Exercise judgment when balancing business priorities, stakeholder expectations, timelines, and creative quality. Cross-department collaboration: Partner directly with marketing leaders, product teams, subject matter experts, and senior stakeholders to transform complex ideas into clear and engaging visual communications. Analyze, reorganize, and synthesize large volumes of information to improve clarity, narrative flow, and audience comprehension. Brand & creative management: Ensure consistency with brand standards while identifying opportunities to evolve and elevate visual systems, design patterns and communication approaches. Present design rationale and recommendations confidently to stakeholders and incorporate feedback effectively for highly efficient products. Identify opportunities to improve workflows, presentation standards, templates, and design processes. Tech Skills What you bring: Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Digital Design, UX/UI, or a related field. Proficiency in English at a bilingual conversational level is a MUST-HAVE. All work is carried out alongside a global team of marketing professionals across several countries. 6+ years of experience in graphic and digital design, with a strong focus on web-based environments. Strong understanding of UX/UI principles, responsive design, and user-centered methodologies. A strong portfolio that showcases creativity, attention to detail, design thinking, excellent graphic quality and a wide range of design styles. Expert-level proficiency in digital design tools, including Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator. Proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite of tools (Word, Powerpoint). Desired knowledge in Webflow. Desired proficiency in AI-tools aimed at UX/UI development / prototyping and innovation. Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and modern layout frameworks to effectively collaborate with development teams and ensure design feasibility. Experience designing and optimizing websites, landing pages, microsites, and interactive web components for B2B audiences. Familiarity with design systems and component libraries to ensure consistency and scalability across digital assets. Awareness of accessibility standards (WCAG) and best practices for inclusive digital design. Bonus points for experience in interactive design, motion graphics, basic video production. Soft Skills Critical thinking to understand, reorganize, simplify, conceptualize, and visualize information more effectively in digital environments. Ability to lead the creative team in the development or iteration of digital innovations, and present design concepts clearly and effectively. Ability to work independently and collaboratively with a global team in a fast-paced environment. Strong time management skills, with the ability to prioritize and meet deadlines. What You Can Expect Excellent compensation (above standard) & indefinite contract. Great work/life balance: hybrid routine, regular office shift. A company supportive of your career and professional development. Paid time off (PTO) and wellness and healthcare benefits (prepaid medicine). A great compensation package and performance bonus opportunities, benefits you'd expect and maybe a few that would pleasantly surprise you (like tuition reimbursement). This position is eligible to participate in an annual incentive program. About TTEC Our business is about making customers happy. That's all we do. Since 1982, we've helped companies build engaged, pleased, profitable customer experiences powered by our combination of humanity and technology. On behalf of many of the world's leading iconic and hypergrowth brands, we talk, message, text, and video chat with millions of customers every day. These exceptional customer experiences start with you. TTEC is proud to be an equal opportunity employer where all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. TTEC embraces and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce that respects and empowers the cultures and perspectives within our global teams. We aim to reflect the communities we serve, by not only delivering amazing service and technology, but also humanity. We make it a point to make sure all our employees feel valued, belonging, and comfortable being their authentic selves at work. As a global company, we know diversity is our strength because it enables us to view things from different vantage points and for you to bring value to the table in your own unique way. - Hybrid Primary Location Colombia-Distrito Capital de Bogota-Bogota

Company Description

Experian es una empresa global de datos y tecnología que impulsa oportunidades para personas y negocios en todo el mundo. Ayudamos a redefinir prácticas de préstamos, descubrir y prevenir el fraude, simplificar la atención médica, crear soluciones de marketing y obtener perspectivas más profundas del mercado automotriz, todo utilizando nuestra combinación única de datos, análisis y software. También asistimos a millones de personas a alcanzar sus metas financieras y ayudarles a ahorrar tiempo y dinero.

Operamos en una variedad de mercados, desde servicios financieros hasta atención médica, automotriz, agroindustria, seguros y muchos otros segmentos industriales.

Invertimos en personas y nuevas tecnologías avanzadas para desbloquear el poder de los datos. Como empresa del índice FTSE 100, cotizada en la Bolsa de Valores de Londres (EXPN), contamos con un equipo de 22,500 personas en 32 países. Nuestra sede corporativa está en Dublín, Irlanda. Obtenga más información en experianplc.com.

Job Description

Propósito del cargo:

Ser responsable integral de la experiencia y evolución del journey del cliente dentro del ecosistema MiDataCrédito, asegurando una experiencia fluida, consistente, simple y libre de fricciones en cada punto de interacción, desde la adquisición y activación hasta el uso recurrente, conversión, retención y adopción de productos y servicios.

El rol liderará la optimización continua de los journeys, funcionalidades, contenidos, herramientas y experiencias digitales que soportan el crecimiento de ECS, garantizando que cada etapa sea medible, escalable y orientada a maximizar la satisfacción, conversión, engagement, retención y valor generado por cliente.

Asimismo, será responsable de identificar oportunidades de mejora a partir de investigación de usuarios, analítica de comportamiento, experimentación e inteligencia artificial, trabajando de manera transversal con Producto, Tecnología, Analítica, Marketing, Comercial y Servicio al Cliente.

El cargo tendrá un rol relevante en el cumplimiento del objetivo de crecimiento del 20% en ECS, acelerando mejoras de producto, optimizando la experiencia en app, portales, marketplace, chatbot y soluciones de educación financiera, y transformando insights de clientes y datos en resultados medibles para el negocio.

Responsabilidades Del Cargo



- Diseñar y optimizar experiencias digitales en canales web, móviles, marketplace y soluciones conversacionales.
- Investigar necesidades, comportamientos y motivaciones de los usuarios mediante entrevistas, encuestas, pruebas de usabilidad y análisis de feedback.
- Crear wireframes, prototipos y propuestas de experiencia centradas en el usuario.
- Analizar métricas, funnels y comportamiento digital para identificar oportunidades de mejora en conversión, engagement y retención.
- Diseñar, ejecutar y evaluar experimentos y pruebas A/B para validar iniciativas de optimización.
- Liderar la evolución de experiencias impulsadas por inteligencia artificial, incluyendo chatbots y soluciones de personalización.
- Mejorar la experiencia de productos financieros, score de crédito, educación financiera y procesos de pago y financiación.
- Traducir insights de clientes y datos de negocio en recomendaciones accionables para equipos de Producto y Tecnología.
- Trabajar de forma transversal con Producto, Tecnología, Analítica, Marketing y áreas comerciales para impulsar resultados de negocio.
- Promover una cultura de diseño, innovación, experimentación y toma de decisiones basada en datos.

Qualifications

Educación



- Profesional en Diseño, Diseño de Interacción, Ingeniería, Psicología, Administración, Marketing, Comunicación o carreras afines.
- Deseable especialización o certificaciones en UX/UI, Product Design, Customer Experience, Analítica o Inteligencia Artificial.

Experiencia



- 5 años de experiencia en UX/UI, Product Design o Customer Experience.
- Experiencia en productos digitales web y móviles.
- Experiencia en investigación de usuarios y pruebas de usabilidad.
- Experiencia en analítica digital, optimización y pruebas A/B.
- Trabajo con equipos de Producto, Tecnología y Analítica.
- Deseable experiencia en fintech, servicios financieros o marketplaces.

Conocimientos



- UX/UI, Product Design y Customer Experience.
- Inteligencia Artificial Generativa y experiencias conversacionales.
- Figma, FigJam y Design Systems.
- Analítica digital, Voice of Customer y A/B Testing.
- Agile, Design Thinking y Service Design.
- Deseable SQL y herramientas de visualización de datos.

Habilidades



- Orientación al cliente.
- Pensamiento estratégico y analítico.
- Mentalidad de producto.
- Toma de decisiones basada en datos.
- Innovación y creatividad.

Additional Information

Nuestra singularidad es que celebramos eso que nos hace diferentes. La cultura y el personal de Experian son elementos diferenciadores clave. Nos tomamos muy en serio nuestra agenda de personas y nos centramos en lo que realmente importa: DEI, conciliación de la vida laboral y personal, desarrollo, autenticidad, compromiso, colaboración, bienestar, recompensa y reconocimiento, voluntariado... y la lista continúa. El sólido enfoque de Experian, en el que las personas son lo primero, ha sido premiado: Great Place To Work™ en 24 países, FORTUNE Best Companies to work y Glassdoor Best Places to Work (globalmente 4,4 estrellas), por nombrar algunos. Eche un vistazo a Experian Life en las redes sociales o a nuestro sitio de empleo para entender por qué.

Experian se enorgullece de ser una empresa que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y acción positiva. La innovación es una parte fundamental del ADN y las prácticas de Experian, y la diversidad de nuestra fuerza laboral impulsa nuestro éxito. Todo el mundo puede tener éxito en Experian y aportar todo de sí independientemente de su género, etnia, religión, color, sexualidad, capacidad física o edad. Si tiene alguna discapacidad o necesidad especial que requiera adaptaciones, por favor háganoslo saber lo antes posible.
